swsh2.name: Caterpie
swsh2.effect: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

swsh2.name: Metapod
swsh2.effect: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

swsh2.name: Butterfree
swsh2.effect: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

swsh2.name: Scyther
swsh2.effect: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.

swsh2.name: Shuckle
swsh2.effect: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

swsh2.name: Heracross
swsh2.effect: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it's not that good at flying.

swsh2.name: Lotad
swsh2.effect: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

swsh2.name: Lombre
swsh2.effect: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

swsh2.name: Ludicolo
swsh2.effect: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

swsh2.name: Surskit
swsh2.effect: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

swsh2.name: Masquerain
swsh2.effect: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

swsh2.name: Snover
swsh2.effect: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.

swsh2.name: Abomasnow
swsh2.effect: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

swsh2.name: Phantump
swsh2.effect: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.

swsh2.name: Trevenant
swsh2.effect: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

swsh2.name: Grubbin
swsh2.effect: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

swsh2.name: Rillaboom V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Rillaboom VMAX
swsh2.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Eldegoss V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Applin
swsh2.effect: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

swsh2.name: Applin
swsh2.effect: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

swsh2.name: Flapple
swsh2.effect: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

swsh2.name: Appletun
swsh2.effect: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

swsh2.name: Vulpix
swsh2.effect: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

swsh2.name: Ninetales
swsh2.effect: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

swsh2.name: Ninetales V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Growlithe
swsh2.effect: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

swsh2.name: Arcanine
swsh2.effect: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

swsh2.name: Magmar
swsh2.effect: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

swsh2.name: Magmortar
swsh2.effect: Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey.

swsh2.name: Litwick
swsh2.effect: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

swsh2.name: Lampent
swsh2.effect: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

swsh2.name: Chandelure
swsh2.effect: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

swsh2.name: Heatmor
swsh2.effect: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

swsh2.name: Cinderace V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Cinderace VMAX
swsh2.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
swsh2.effect: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

swsh2.name: Galarian Mr. Rime
swsh2.effect: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

swsh2.name: Magikarp
swsh2.effect: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

swsh2.name: Gyarados
swsh2.effect: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

swsh2.name: Wingull
swsh2.effect: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

swsh2.name: Pelipper
swsh2.effect: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

swsh2.name: Milotic V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Tympole
swsh2.effect: Graceful ripples running across the water's surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

swsh2.name: Palpitoad
swsh2.effect: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

swsh2.name: Seismitoad
swsh2.effect: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

swsh2.name: Galarian Darumaka
swsh2.effect: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

swsh2.name: Galarian Darmanitan
swsh2.effect: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

swsh2.name: Inteleon V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Inteleon VMAX
swsh2.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Cramorant
swsh2.effect: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

swsh2.name: Arrokuda
swsh2.effect: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

swsh2.name: Barraskewda
swsh2.effect: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

swsh2.name: Eiscue
swsh2.effect: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

swsh2.name: Eiscue V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Voltorb
swsh2.effect: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

swsh2.name: Electrode
swsh2.effect: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

swsh2.name: Electabuzz
swsh2.effect: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

swsh2.name: Electivire
swsh2.effect: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

swsh2.name: Shinx
swsh2.effect: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

swsh2.name: Luxio
swsh2.effect: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

swsh2.name: Luxray
swsh2.effect: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

swsh2.name: Helioptile
swsh2.effect: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

swsh2.name: Heliolisk
swsh2.effect: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

swsh2.name: Charjabug
swsh2.effect: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

swsh2.name: Vikavolt
swsh2.effect: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

swsh2.name: Boltund V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Toxel
swsh2.effect: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

swsh2.name: Toxtricity
swsh2.effect: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

swsh2.name: Toxtricity V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Toxtricity VMAX
swsh2.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Pincurchin V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Morpeko
swsh2.effect: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

swsh2.name: Clefairy
swsh2.effect: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

swsh2.name: Clefable
swsh2.effect: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

swsh2.name: Natu
swsh2.effect: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

swsh2.name: Xatu
swsh2.effect: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

swsh2.name: Galarian Corsola
swsh2.effect: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

swsh2.name: Galarian Cursola
swsh2.effect: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

swsh2.name: Sigilyph
swsh2.effect: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

swsh2.name: Sandygast
swsh2.effect: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

swsh2.name: Palossand
swsh2.effect: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

swsh2.name: Hatenna
swsh2.effect: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

swsh2.name: Hattrem
swsh2.effect: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

swsh2.name: Hatterene
swsh2.effect: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

swsh2.name: Milcery
swsh2.effect: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

swsh2.name: Alcremie
swsh2.effect: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

swsh2.name: Indeedee
swsh2.effect: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

swsh2.name: Dreepy
swsh2.effect: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

swsh2.name: Drakloak
swsh2.effect: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

swsh2.name: Dragapult
swsh2.effect: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

swsh2.name: Dragapult V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Dragapult VMAX
swsh2.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Galarian Farfetch'd
swsh2.effect: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

swsh2.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
swsh2.effect: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

swsh2.name: Nosepass
swsh2.effect: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

swsh2.name: Meditite
swsh2.effect: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

swsh2.name: Medicham
swsh2.effect: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

swsh2.name: Barboach
swsh2.effect: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

swsh2.name: Whiscash
swsh2.effect: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

swsh2.name: Galarian Yamask
swsh2.effect: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

swsh2.name: Galarian Runerigus
swsh2.effect: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

swsh2.name: Binacle
swsh2.effect: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

swsh2.name: Barbaracle
swsh2.effect: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

swsh2.name: Rolycoly
swsh2.effect: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

swsh2.name: Carkol
swsh2.effect: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

swsh2.name: Coalossal
swsh2.effect: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

swsh2.name: Sandaconda V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Falinks
swsh2.effect: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

swsh2.name: Falinks V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Stonjourner
swsh2.effect: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

swsh2.name: Koffing
swsh2.effect: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

swsh2.name: Galarian Weezing
swsh2.effect: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

swsh2.name: Stunky
swsh2.effect: From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.

swsh2.name: Skuntank
swsh2.effect: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon's diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.

swsh2.name: Spiritomb
swsh2.effect: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

swsh2.name: Trubbish
swsh2.effect: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

swsh2.name: Garbodor
swsh2.effect: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

swsh2.name: Vullaby
swsh2.effect: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.

swsh2.name: Mandibuzz
swsh2.effect: Although it's a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they're ready to leave the nest.

swsh2.name: Malamar V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Malamar VMAX
swsh2.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Impidimp
swsh2.effect: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

swsh2.name: Morgrem
swsh2.effect: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

swsh2.name: Grimmsnarl
swsh2.effect: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

swsh2.name: Galarian Meowth
swsh2.effect: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

swsh2.name: Galarian Perrserker
swsh2.effect: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

swsh2.name: Scizor
swsh2.effect: Once it has identified something as an enemy, it will continue beating them with its steel-hard pincers until there's nothing left but scraps.

swsh2.name: Bronzor
swsh2.effect: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn't come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

swsh2.name: Bronzong
swsh2.effect: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

swsh2.name: Probopass
swsh2.effect: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

swsh2.name: Durant
swsh2.effect: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

swsh2.name: Honedge
swsh2.effect: Honedge's soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge's body.

swsh2.name: Doublade
swsh2.effect: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

swsh2.name: Aegislash
swsh2.effect: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

swsh2.name: Copperajah V
swsh2.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Copperajah VMAX
swsh2.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh2.name: Duraludon
swsh2.effect: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

swsh2.name: Zacian
swsh2.effect: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

swsh2.name: Zamazenta
swsh2.effect: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

swsh2.name: Snorlax
swsh2.effect: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

swsh2.name: Chatot
swsh2.effect: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

swsh2.name: Pidove
swsh2.effect: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful—several hundred of them can gather at once.

swsh2.name: Tranquill
swsh2.effect: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

swsh2.name: Unfezant
swsh2.effect: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

swsh2.name: Bunnelby
swsh2.effect: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

swsh2.name: Diggersby
swsh2.effect: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

swsh2.name: Hawlucha
swsh2.effect: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

swsh2.name: Stufful
swsh2.effect: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

swsh2.name: Bewear
swsh2.effect: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

swsh2.name: Skwovet
swsh2.effect: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

swsh2.name: Greedent
swsh2.effect: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

If the Fire Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh2.name: Full Heal
swsh2.effect: Your Active Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh2.name: Nugget
swsh2.effect: You can play this card only if you drew it from your deck at the beginning of your turn, before you put it into your hand. Draw 3 cards. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh2.name: Oleana

swsh2.name: Poké Ball
swsh2.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh2.name: Scoop Up Net
swsh2.effect: Put 1 of your Pokémon that isn't a Pokémon V or a Pokémon-GX into your hand. (Discard all attached cards.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh2.name: Training Court

swsh2.name: Turffield Stadium
swsh2.effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for an Evolution Grass Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck. This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

swsh2.name: Capture Energy
swsh2.effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to a Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh2.name: Horror Psychic Energy
swsh2.effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Psychic Energy. If the Psychic Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out), put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

swsh2.name: Speed Lightning Energy
swsh2.effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Lightning Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to a Lightning Pokémon, draw 2 cards.

swsh2.name: Twin Energy
swsh2.effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon that isn't a Pokémon V or a Pokémon-GX, it provides ColorlessColorless Energy. If this card is attached to a Pokémon V or a Pokémon-GX, it provides Colorless Energy instead.

swsh2.name: Frosmoth
swsh2.effect: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

swsh2.name: Galarian Perrserker
swsh2.effect: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

swsh2.name: Big Charm
swsh2.effect: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. The Pokémon this card is attached to gets +30 HP. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Paras
swsh3.effect: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

swsh3.name: Parasect
swsh3.effect: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

swsh3.name: Carnivine
swsh3.effect: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

swsh3.name: Pansage
swsh3.effect: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

swsh3.name: Simisage
swsh3.effect: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

swsh3.name: Karrablast
swsh3.effect: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

swsh3.name: Shelmet
swsh3.effect: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.

swsh3.name: Accelgor
swsh3.effect: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

swsh3.name: Rowlet
swsh3.effect: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

swsh3.name: Dartrix
swsh3.effect: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

swsh3.name: Decidueye
swsh3.effect: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

swsh3.name: Bounsweet
swsh3.effect: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.

swsh3.name: Steenee
swsh3.effect: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.

swsh3.name: Tsareena
swsh3.effect: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

swsh3.name: Wimpod
swsh3.effect: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

swsh3.name: Golisopod
swsh3.effect: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

swsh3.name: Charizard V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Charizard VMAX
swsh3.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Houndoom V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Torchic
swsh3.effect: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

swsh3.name: Combusken
swsh3.effect: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

swsh3.name: Blaziken
swsh3.effect: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

swsh3.name: Heatran
swsh3.effect: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

swsh3.name: Pansear
swsh3.effect: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

swsh3.name: Simisear
swsh3.effect: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

swsh3.name: Galarian Darmanitan
swsh3.effect: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

swsh3.name: Larvesta
swsh3.effect: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

swsh3.name: Volcarona
swsh3.effect: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

swsh3.name: Fletchinder
swsh3.effect: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

swsh3.name: Talonflame
swsh3.effect: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

swsh3.name: Centiskorch V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Centiskorch VMAX
swsh3.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
swsh3.effect: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

swsh3.name: Galarian Mr. Rime
swsh3.effect: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

swsh3.name: Suicune
swsh3.effect: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

swsh3.name: Feebas
swsh3.effect: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

swsh3.name: Milotic
swsh3.effect: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

swsh3.name: Relicanth
swsh3.effect: The reason it hasn't changed at all in a hundred million years is that it's apparently already a perfect life-form.

swsh3.name: Panpour
swsh3.effect: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

swsh3.name: Simipour
swsh3.effect: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

swsh3.name: Galarian Darumaka
swsh3.effect: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

swsh3.name: Galarian Darmanitan
swsh3.effect: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

swsh3.name: Vanillite
swsh3.effect: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

swsh3.name: Vanillish
swsh3.effect: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

swsh3.name: Vanilluxe
swsh3.effect: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

swsh3.name: Cubchoo
swsh3.effect: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

swsh3.name: Beartic
swsh3.effect: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

swsh3.name: Wishiwashi
swsh3.effect: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

swsh3.name: Mareanie
swsh3.effect: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

swsh3.name: Toxapex
swsh3.effect: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

swsh3.name: Dracovish
swsh3.effect: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

swsh3.name: Arctovish
swsh3.effect: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

swsh3.name: Mareep
swsh3.effect: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

swsh3.name: Flaaffy
swsh3.effect: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

swsh3.name: Ampharos
swsh3.effect: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

swsh3.name: Electrike
swsh3.effect: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

swsh3.name: Manectric
swsh3.effect: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

swsh3.name: Vikavolt V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Tapu Koko
swsh3.effect: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

swsh3.name: Toxel
swsh3.effect: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

swsh3.name: Toxtricity
swsh3.effect: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

swsh3.name: Pincurchin
swsh3.effect: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

swsh3.name: Dracozolt
swsh3.effect: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

swsh3.name: Arctozolt
swsh3.effect: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

swsh3.name: Jigglypuff
swsh3.effect: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

swsh3.name: Wigglytuff
swsh3.effect: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

swsh3.name: Mew V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Snubbull
swsh3.effect: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

swsh3.name: Granbull
swsh3.effect: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

swsh3.name: Lunatone
swsh3.effect: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

swsh3.name: Gothita
swsh3.effect: Though they're still only babies, there's psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

swsh3.name: Gothorita
swsh3.effect: It's said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

swsh3.name: Gothitelle
swsh3.effect: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

swsh3.name: Golett
swsh3.effect: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

swsh3.name: Golurk
swsh3.effect: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

swsh3.name: Dedenne
swsh3.effect: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

swsh3.name: Morelull
swsh3.effect: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

swsh3.name: Shiinotic
swsh3.effect: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

swsh3.name: Mimikyu
swsh3.effect: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

swsh3.name: Sinistea
swsh3.effect: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

swsh3.name: Polteageist
swsh3.effect: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

swsh3.name: Diglett
swsh3.effect: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

swsh3.name: Dugtrio
swsh3.effect: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

swsh3.name: Larvitar
swsh3.effect: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

swsh3.name: Pupitar
swsh3.effect: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

swsh3.name: Tyranitar
swsh3.effect: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

swsh3.name: Trapinch
swsh3.effect: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

swsh3.name: Vibrava
swsh3.effect: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

swsh3.name: Flygon
swsh3.effect: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

swsh3.name: Solrock
swsh3.effect: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

swsh3.name: Hippopotas
swsh3.effect: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.

swsh3.name: Hippowdon
swsh3.effect: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

swsh3.name: Rhyperior V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Diggersby
swsh3.effect: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

swsh3.name: Passimian
swsh3.effect: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

swsh3.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
swsh3.effect: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

swsh3.name: Galarian Slowbro V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Grimer
swsh3.effect: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

swsh3.name: Muk
swsh3.effect: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

swsh3.name: Spinarak
swsh3.effect: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

swsh3.name: Ariados
swsh3.effect: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

swsh3.name: Crobat V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Darkrai
swsh3.effect: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

swsh3.name: Purrloin
swsh3.effect: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

swsh3.name: Liepard
swsh3.effect: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

swsh3.name: Deino
swsh3.effect: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.

swsh3.name: Zweilous
swsh3.effect: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.

swsh3.name: Hydreigon
swsh3.effect: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

swsh3.name: Hoopa
swsh3.effect: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

swsh3.name: Nickit
swsh3.effect: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

swsh3.name: Thievul
swsh3.effect: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

swsh3.name: Grimmsnarl V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Grimmsnarl VMAX
swsh3.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Eternatus V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Eternatus VMAX
swsh3.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Scizor V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Scizor VMAX
swsh3.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Skarmory
swsh3.effect: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

swsh3.name: Aron
swsh3.effect: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

swsh3.name: Lairon
swsh3.effect: It habitually shows off its strength with the sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

swsh3.name: Aggron
swsh3.effect: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

swsh3.name: Escavalier
swsh3.effect: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

swsh3.name: Klink
swsh3.effect: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

swsh3.name: Klang
swsh3.effect: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

swsh3.name: Klinklang
swsh3.effect: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

swsh3.name: Galarian Stunfisk V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Meltan
swsh3.effect: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

swsh3.name: Melmetal
swsh3.effect: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

swsh3.name: Cufant
swsh3.effect: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

swsh3.name: Copperajah
swsh3.effect: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

swsh3.name: Kangaskhan
swsh3.effect: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

swsh3.name: Tauros
swsh3.effect: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

swsh3.name: Sentret
swsh3.effect: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

swsh3.name: Furret
swsh3.effect: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

swsh3.name: Dunsparce
swsh3.effect: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

swsh3.name: Teddiursa
swsh3.effect: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

swsh3.name: Ursaring
swsh3.effect: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

swsh3.name: Lugia
swsh3.effect: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

swsh3.name: Skitty
swsh3.effect: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

swsh3.name: Delcatty
swsh3.effect: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

swsh3.name: Salamence V
swsh3.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Salamence VMAX
swsh3.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh3.name: Starly
swsh3.effect: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

swsh3.name: Staravia
swsh3.effect: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

swsh3.name: Staraptor
swsh3.effect: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

swsh3.name: Ducklett
swsh3.effect: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

swsh3.name: Swanna
swsh3.effect: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

swsh3.name: Bunnelby
swsh3.effect: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

swsh3.name: Fletchling
swsh3.effect: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

swsh3.name: Skwovet
swsh3.effect: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

swsh3.name: Greedent
swsh3.effect: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

swsh3.name: Rookidee
swsh3.effect: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

swsh3.name: Corvisquire
swsh3.effect: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

swsh3.name: Corviknight
swsh3.effect: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

swsh3.name: Big Parasol
swsh3.effect: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. As long as the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, prevent all effects of attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh3.name: Billowing Smoke
swsh3.effect: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, that player discards any Prize cards they would take for that Knock Out instead of putting those cards into their hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh3.name: Bird Keeper
swsh3.effect: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh3.name: Cape of Toughness

swsh3.name: Glimwood Tangle
swsh3.effect: Once during each player's turn, after that player flips any coins for an attack, they may ignore all results of those coin flips and begin flipping those coins again. This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

swsh3.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, put a card from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh3.name: Piers

swsh3.effect: Choose up to 2 of your Pokémon in play. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Pokémon that was put into play this turn. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh3.name: Rare Fossil

swsh3.name: Spikemuth

swsh3.effect: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

fut20.name: Pikachu on the Ball
fut20.effect: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

fut20.name: Eevee on the Ball
fut20.effect: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

fut20.name: Grookey on the Ball
fut20.effect: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

fut20.name: Scorbunny on the Ball
fut20.effect: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

fut20.name: Sobble on the Ball
fut20.effect: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

swsh35.name: Venusaur V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Weedle
swsh35.effect: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

swsh35.name: Kakuna
swsh35.effect: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

swsh35.name: Beedrill
swsh35.effect: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

swsh35.name: Eldegoss V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Vulpix
swsh35.effect: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

swsh35.name: Victini
swsh35.effect: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

swsh35.name: Incineroar V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Sizzlipede
swsh35.effect: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

swsh35.name: Centiskorch
swsh35.effect: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

swsh35.name: Carvanha
swsh35.effect: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

swsh35.name: Sharpedo
swsh35.effect: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

swsh35.name: Wailord V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Drednaw V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Gardevoir VMAX
swsh35.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Hatenna
swsh35.effect: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

swsh35.name: Hattrem
swsh35.effect: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

swsh35.name: Hatterene
swsh35.effect: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

swsh35.name: Galarian Cursola V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Alcremie V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Alcremie VMAX
swsh35.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Machop
swsh35.effect: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

swsh35.name: Machoke
swsh35.effect: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

swsh35.name: Machamp
swsh35.effect: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

swsh35.name: Lucario V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Zygarde
swsh35.effect: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

swsh35.name: Rockruff
swsh35.effect: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

swsh35.name: Lycanroc
swsh35.effect: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.

swsh35.name: Rolycoly
swsh35.effect: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

swsh35.name: Grapploct V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Ekans
swsh35.effect: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

swsh35.name: Arbok
swsh35.effect: After stunning its opponents with the pattern on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its body and waits for them to stop moving.

swsh35.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
swsh35.effect: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

swsh35.name: Galarian Linoone
swsh35.effect: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

swsh35.name: Galarian Obstagoon
swsh35.effect: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

swsh35.name: Absol
swsh35.effect: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

swsh35.name: Purrloin
swsh35.effect: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

swsh35.name: Liepard
swsh35.effect: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

swsh35.name: Scraggy
swsh35.effect: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.

swsh35.name: Scrafty
swsh35.effect: As halfhearted as this Pokémon's kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr's concrete pillars.

swsh35.name: Trubbish
swsh35.effect: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

swsh35.name: Inkay
swsh35.effect: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

swsh35.name: Malamar
swsh35.effect: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

swsh35.name: Nickit
swsh35.effect: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

swsh35.name: Duraludon V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Swablu
swsh35.effect: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

swsh35.name: Altaria
swsh35.effect: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

swsh35.name: Bede

swsh35.name: Full Heal
swsh35.effect: Remove all Special Conditions from your Active Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh35.name: Great Ball

swsh35.effect: Draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh35.name: Milo
swsh35.effect: Discard up to 2 cards from your hand, and draw 2 cards for each card you discarded in this way. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
