swsh35.effect: Search your deck for an Energy card and a Darkness Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh35.name: Poké Ball
swsh35.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh35.name: Pokémon Center Lady
swsh35.effect: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, and it recovers from all Special Conditions. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh35.name: Potion
swsh35.effect: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh35.name: Professor's Research (Professor Magnolia)
swsh35.effect: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh35.name: Rotom Bike
swsh35.effect: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. Your turn ends. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh35.name: Rotom Phone
swsh35.effect: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and shuffle the other cards back into your deck. Then, put the card you chose on top of your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh35.name: Sonia
swsh35.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon or up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh35.name: Suspicious Food Tin
swsh35.effect: Heal 80 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has at least 1 Psychic Energy attached. If you healed any damage in this way, discard a Psychic Energy from it. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh35.name: Team Yell Grunt
swsh35.effect: Put an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon into their hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh35.name: Turffield Stadium
swsh35.effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for an Evolution Grass Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck. This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

swsh35.name: Drednaw V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Gardevoir V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Galarian Cursola V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Grapploct V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Hop
swsh35.effect: Draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh35.name: Charizard VMAX
swsh35.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Drednaw VMAX
swsh35.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Gardevoir VMAX
swsh35.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Kabu
swsh35.effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If your Active Pokémon is your only Pokémon in play, draw 8 cards instead. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh35.name: Piers
swsh35.effect: Search your deck for an Energy card and a Darkness Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh35.name: Charizard V
swsh35.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh35.name: Suspicious Food Tin
swsh35.effect: Heal 80 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has at least 1 Psychic Energy attached. If you healed any damage in this way, discard a Psychic Energy from it. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh4.name: Weedle
swsh4.effect: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

swsh4.name: Kakuna
swsh4.effect: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

swsh4.name: Beedrill
swsh4.effect: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

swsh4.name: Exeggcute
swsh4.effect: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

swsh4.name: Exeggutor
swsh4.effect: Each of its three heads has its own thoughts. When they want to go in different directions, Exeggutor becomes unable to move.

swsh4.name: Yanma
swsh4.effect: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

swsh4.name: Yanmega
swsh4.effect: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

swsh4.name: Pineco
swsh4.effect: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

swsh4.name: Celebi
swsh4.effect: This Pokémon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.

swsh4.name: Seedot
swsh4.effect: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

swsh4.name: Nuzleaf
swsh4.effect: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

swsh4.name: Shiftry
swsh4.effect: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

swsh4.name: Nincada
swsh4.effect: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

swsh4.name: Ninjask
swsh4.effect: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

swsh4.name: Shaymin
swsh4.effect: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

swsh4.name: Genesect
swsh4.effect: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

swsh4.name: Skiddo
swsh4.effect: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

swsh4.name: Gogoat
swsh4.effect: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

swsh4.name: Dhelmise
swsh4.effect: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

swsh4.name: Orbeetle V
swsh4.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Orbeetle VMAX
swsh4.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Zarude V
swsh4.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Charmander
swsh4.effect: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

swsh4.name: Charmeleon
swsh4.effect: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

swsh4.name: Charizard
swsh4.effect: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

swsh4.name: Flareon
swsh4.effect: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

swsh4.name: Slugma
swsh4.effect: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

swsh4.name: Magcargo
swsh4.effect: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

swsh4.name: Talonflame V
swsh4.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Vaporeon
swsh4.effect: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

swsh4.name: Wailmer
swsh4.effect: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

swsh4.name: Wailord
swsh4.effect: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

swsh4.name: Oshawott
swsh4.effect: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

swsh4.name: Dewott
swsh4.effect: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

swsh4.name: Samurott
swsh4.effect: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

swsh4.name: Galarian Darmanitan V
swsh4.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Galarian Darmanitan VMAX
swsh4.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Chewtle
swsh4.effect: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

swsh4.name: Drednaw
swsh4.effect: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

swsh4.name: Cramorant
swsh4.effect: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

swsh4.name: Arrokuda
swsh4.effect: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

swsh4.name: Barraskewda
swsh4.effect: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

swsh4.name: Pikachu V
swsh4.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Pikachu VMAX
swsh4.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Voltorb
swsh4.effect: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

swsh4.name: Electrode
swsh4.effect: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

swsh4.name: Jolteon
swsh4.effect: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

swsh4.name: Zapdos
swsh4.effect: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

swsh4.name: Ampharos V
swsh4.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Raikou
swsh4.effect: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

swsh4.name: Electrike
swsh4.effect: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

swsh4.name: Manectric
swsh4.effect: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

swsh4.name: Blitzle
swsh4.effect: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

swsh4.name: Zebstrika
swsh4.effect: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

swsh4.name: Joltik
swsh4.effect: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.

swsh4.name: Galvantula
swsh4.effect: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

swsh4.name: Tynamo
swsh4.effect: One alone can emit only trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

swsh4.name: Eelektrik
swsh4.effect: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

swsh4.name: Eelektross
swsh4.effect: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

swsh4.name: Zekrom
swsh4.effect: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

swsh4.name: Zeraora
swsh4.effect: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

swsh4.name: Pincurchin
swsh4.effect: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

swsh4.name: Clefairy
swsh4.effect: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

swsh4.name: Clefable
swsh4.effect: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

swsh4.name: Girafarig
swsh4.effect: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

swsh4.name: Shedinja
swsh4.effect: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

swsh4.name: Shuppet
swsh4.effect: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

swsh4.name: Banette
swsh4.effect: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

swsh4.name: Duskull
swsh4.effect: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

swsh4.name: Dusclops
swsh4.effect: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

swsh4.name: Dusknoir
swsh4.effect: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

swsh4.name: Chimecho
swsh4.effect: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

swsh4.name: Woobat
swsh4.effect: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.

swsh4.name: Swoobat
swsh4.effect: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won't be able to fly for a little while.

swsh4.name: Cottonee
swsh4.effect: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

swsh4.name: Whimsicott
swsh4.effect: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

swsh4.name: Dedenne
swsh4.effect: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

swsh4.name: Xerneas
swsh4.effect: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

swsh4.name: Diancie
swsh4.effect: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

swsh4.name: Milcery
swsh4.effect: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

swsh4.name: Alcremie
swsh4.effect: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

swsh4.name: Zacian
swsh4.effect: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

swsh4.name: Wooper
swsh4.effect: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

swsh4.name: Quagsire
swsh4.effect: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

swsh4.name: Shuckle
swsh4.effect: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

swsh4.name: Phanpy
swsh4.effect: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

swsh4.name: Donphan
swsh4.effect: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

swsh4.name: Hitmontop
swsh4.effect: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

swsh4.name: Regirock
swsh4.effect: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

swsh4.name: Riolu
swsh4.effect: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

swsh4.name: Drilbur
swsh4.effect: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

swsh4.name: Terrakion
swsh4.effect: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

swsh4.name: Zygarde
swsh4.effect: Born when all of Zygarde's cells have been gathered together, it uses force to neutralize those who harm the ecosystem.

swsh4.name: Rockruff
swsh4.effect: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

swsh4.name: Lycanroc
swsh4.effect: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

swsh4.name: Mudbray
swsh4.effect: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It's skilled at making use of mud.

swsh4.name: Mudsdale
swsh4.effect: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

swsh4.name: Coalossal V
swsh4.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Coalossal VMAX
swsh4.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Clobbopus
swsh4.effect: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

swsh4.name: Grapploct
swsh4.effect: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

swsh4.name: Zamazenta
swsh4.effect: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

swsh4.name: Poochyena
swsh4.effect: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

swsh4.name: Mightyena
swsh4.effect: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

swsh4.name: Sableye
swsh4.effect: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

swsh4.name: Drapion V
swsh4.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Sandile
swsh4.effect: Sandile's still not good at hunting, so it mostly eats things that have collapsed in the desert. It's called "the cleaner of the desert."

swsh4.name: Krokorok
swsh4.effect: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

swsh4.name: Krookodile
swsh4.effect: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.

swsh4.name: Trubbish
swsh4.effect: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

swsh4.name: Garbodor
swsh4.effect: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

swsh4.name: Galarian Meowth
swsh4.effect: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

swsh4.name: Galarian Perrserker
swsh4.effect: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

swsh4.name: Forretress
swsh4.effect: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

swsh4.name: Steelix V
swsh4.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Beldum
swsh4.effect: If you anger it, it will do more than rampage. It will also burst out strong magnetism, causing nearby machines to break.

swsh4.name: Metang
swsh4.effect: It flies at high speeds around the skies. When it finds its prey, Metang takes a firm grip with its sharp claws and never lets go.

swsh4.name: Metagross
swsh4.effect: It analyzes its opponents with more accuracy than a supercomputer, which enables it to calmly back them into a corner.

swsh4.name: Jirachi
swsh4.effect: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near-perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.

swsh4.name: Lucario
swsh4.effect: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

swsh4.name: Dialga
swsh4.effect: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

swsh4.name: Excadrill
swsh4.effect: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

swsh4.name: Ferroseed
swsh4.effect: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

swsh4.name: Ferrothorn
swsh4.effect: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

swsh4.name: Galarian Stunfisk
swsh4.effect: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

swsh4.name: Aegislash V
swsh4.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Aegislash VMAX
swsh4.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Magearna
swsh4.effect: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

swsh4.name: Duraludon
swsh4.effect: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

swsh4.name: Eevee
swsh4.effect: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

swsh4.name: Snorlax
swsh4.effect: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

swsh4.name: Lugia
swsh4.effect: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

swsh4.name: Taillow
swsh4.effect: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

swsh4.name: Swellow
swsh4.effect: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

swsh4.name: Whismur
swsh4.effect: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

swsh4.name: Loudred
swsh4.effect: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

swsh4.name: Exploud
swsh4.effect: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor—or like an earthquake has struck.

swsh4.name: Rayquaza
swsh4.effect: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

swsh4.name: Chatot
swsh4.effect: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

swsh4.name: Togekiss V
swsh4.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Togekiss VMAX
swsh4.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh4.name: Tornadus
swsh4.effect: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

swsh4.name: Pikipek
swsh4.effect: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

swsh4.name: Trumbeak
swsh4.effect: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

swsh4.name: Toucannon
swsh4.effect: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

swsh4.name: Allister
swsh4.effect: Draw 3 cards. If you drew any cards in this way, discard up to 3 cards from your hand. (You must discard at least 1 card.) You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh4.name: Bea
swsh4.effect: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck, and attach any Energy cards you discarded in this way to your Benched Fighting Pokémon in any way you like. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh4.name: Beauty
swsh4.effect: If you go first, you may play this card during your first turn. Draw 2 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh4.name: Cara Liss
swsh4.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Rare Fossil cards and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh4.name: Circhester Bath
swsh4.effect: All Basic Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) take 20 less damage from attacks from the opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

swsh4.name: Drone Rotom
swsh4.effect: Your opponent reveals their hand. If they do, look at the top card of your opponent's deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh4.name: Hero's Medal
swsh4.effect: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. The Pokémon VMAX this card is attached to gets -100 HP, and if it is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. You can't attach this card to a Pokémon VMAX that has 100 HP or less remaining. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh4.name: League Staff
swsh4.effect: Draw 2 cards. If Wyndon Stadium is in play, draw 2 more cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh4.name: Leon
swsh4.effect: During this turn, your Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh4.name: Memory Capsule
swsh4.effect: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. The Pokémon this card is attached to can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. mcd21.name: Grookey

mcd21.name: Torchic

mcd21.name: Chimchar

mcd21.name: Mudkip

swsh45sv.effect: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

swsh45sv.name: Suicune
swsh45sv.effect: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Darumaka
swsh45sv.effect: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Darmanitan
swsh45sv.effect: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

swsh45sv.name: Sobble
swsh45sv.effect: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

swsh45sv.name: Drizzile
swsh45sv.effect: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

swsh45sv.name: Inteleon
swsh45sv.effect: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

swsh45sv.name: Chewtle
swsh45sv.effect: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

swsh45sv.name: Drednaw
swsh45sv.effect: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

swsh45sv.name: Cramorant
swsh45sv.effect: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

swsh45sv.name: Arrokuda
swsh45sv.effect: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

swsh45sv.name: Barraskewda
swsh45sv.effect: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

swsh45sv.name: Snom
swsh45sv.effect: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

swsh45sv.name: Frosmoth
swsh45sv.effect: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

swsh45sv.name: Eiscue
swsh45sv.effect: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

swsh45sv.name: Dracovish
swsh45sv.effect: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

swsh45sv.name: Arctovish
swsh45sv.effect: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

swsh45sv.name: Rotom
swsh45sv.effect: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

swsh45sv.name: Yamper
swsh45sv.effect: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

swsh45sv.name: Boltund
swsh45sv.effect: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

swsh45sv.name: Toxel
swsh45sv.effect: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

swsh45sv.name: Toxtricity
swsh45sv.effect: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

swsh45sv.name: Pincurchin
swsh45sv.effect: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

swsh45sv.name: Morpeko
swsh45sv.effect: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

swsh45sv.name: Dracozolt
swsh45sv.effect: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

swsh45sv.name: Arctozolt
swsh45sv.effect: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Ponyta
swsh45sv.effect: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Rapidash
swsh45sv.effect: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Corsola
swsh45sv.effect: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Cursola
swsh45sv.effect: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

swsh45sv.name: Dedenne
swsh45sv.effect: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

swsh45sv.name: Sinistea
swsh45sv.effect: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

swsh45sv.name: Polteageist
swsh45sv.effect: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

swsh45sv.name: Hatenna
swsh45sv.effect: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

swsh45sv.name: Hattrem
swsh45sv.effect: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

swsh45sv.name: Hatterene
swsh45sv.effect: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

swsh45sv.name: Milcery
swsh45sv.effect: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

swsh45sv.name: Alcremie
swsh45sv.effect: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

swsh45sv.name: Indeedee
swsh45sv.effect: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

swsh45sv.name: Dreepy
swsh45sv.effect: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

swsh45sv.name: Drakloak
swsh45sv.effect: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

swsh45sv.name: Dragapult
swsh45sv.effect: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Farfetch'd
swsh45sv.effect: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
swsh45sv.effect: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Yamask
swsh45sv.effect: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Runerigus
swsh45sv.effect: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

swsh45sv.name: Rolycoly
swsh45sv.effect: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

swsh45sv.name: Carkol
swsh45sv.effect: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

swsh45sv.name: Coalossal
swsh45sv.effect: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

swsh45sv.name: Silicobra
swsh45sv.effect: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

swsh45sv.name: Sandaconda
swsh45sv.effect: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

swsh45sv.name: Clobbopus
swsh45sv.effect: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

swsh45sv.name: Grapploct
swsh45sv.effect: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

swsh45sv.name: Falinks
swsh45sv.effect: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

swsh45sv.name: Stonjourner
swsh45sv.effect: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

swsh45sv.name: Koffing
swsh45sv.effect: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Weezing
swsh45sv.effect: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
swsh45sv.effect: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Linoone
swsh45sv.effect: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Obstagoon
swsh45sv.effect: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

swsh45sv.name: Nickit
swsh45sv.effect: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

swsh45sv.name: Thievul
swsh45sv.effect: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

swsh45sv.name: Impidimp
swsh45sv.effect: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

swsh45sv.name: Morgrem
swsh45sv.effect: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

swsh45sv.name: Grimmsnarl
swsh45sv.effect: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Meowth
swsh45sv.effect: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Perrserker
swsh45sv.effect: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

swsh45sv.name: Galarian Stunfisk
swsh45sv.effect: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

swsh45sv.name: Corviknight
swsh45sv.effect: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

swsh45sv.name: Cufant
swsh45sv.effect: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

swsh45sv.name: Copperajah
swsh45sv.effect: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

swsh45sv.name: Duraludon
swsh45sv.effect: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

swsh45sv.name: Minccino
swsh45sv.effect: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

swsh45sv.name: Cinccino
swsh45sv.effect: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

swsh45sv.name: Ducklett
swsh45sv.effect: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

swsh45sv.name: Swanna
swsh45sv.effect: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

swsh45sv.name: Bunnelby
swsh45sv.effect: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

swsh45sv.name: Oranguru
swsh45sv.effect: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

swsh45sv.name: Skwovet
swsh45sv.effect: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

swsh45sv.name: Greedent
swsh45sv.effect: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

swsh45sv.name: Rookidee
swsh45sv.effect: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

swsh45sv.name: Corvisquire
swsh45sv.effect: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

swsh45sv.name: Wooloo
swsh45sv.effect: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

swsh45sv.name: Dubwool
swsh45sv.effect: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

swsh45sv.name: Rillaboom V
swsh45sv.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Rillaboom VMAX
swsh45sv.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Charizard VMAX
swsh45sv.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Centiskorch V
swsh45sv.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Centiskorch VMAX
swsh45sv.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Lapras V
swsh45sv.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Lapras VMAX
swsh45sv.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Toxtricity V
swsh45sv.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Toxtricity VMAX
swsh45sv.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Indeedee V
swsh45sv.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Falinks V
swsh45sv.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Grimmsnarl V
swsh45sv.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Grimmsnarl VMAX
swsh45sv.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Ditto V
swsh45sv.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Ditto VMAX
swsh45sv.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Dubwool V
swsh45sv.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Eternatus V
swsh45sv.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh45sv.name: Eternatus VMAX
swsh45sv.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Bellsprout
swsh5.effect: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

swsh5.name: Weepinbell
swsh5.effect: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

swsh5.name: Victreebel
swsh5.effect: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

swsh5.name: Cacnea
swsh5.effect: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

swsh5.name: Cacturne
swsh5.effect: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

swsh5.name: Kricketune V
swsh5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Cherubi
swsh5.effect: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

swsh5.name: Cherrim
swsh5.effect: The faint scent that emanates from its full blossom entices bug Pokémon to it.

swsh5.name: Carnivine
swsh5.effect: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

swsh5.name: Durant
swsh5.effect: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

swsh5.name: Scatterbug
swsh5.effect: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

swsh5.name: Spewpa
swsh5.effect: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

swsh5.name: Vivillon
swsh5.effect: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

swsh5.name: Fomantis
swsh5.effect: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.

swsh5.name: Lurantis
swsh5.effect: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.

swsh5.name: Tapu Bulu
swsh5.effect: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

swsh5.name: Blipbug
swsh5.effect: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

swsh5.name: Flapple V
swsh5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Flapple VMAX
swsh5.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Entei
swsh5.effect: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

swsh5.name: Victini V
swsh5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Victini VMAX
swsh5.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Tepig
swsh5.effect: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

swsh5.name: Pignite
swsh5.effect: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

swsh5.name: Emboar
swsh5.effect: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

swsh5.name: Heatmor
swsh5.effect: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

swsh5.name: Salandit
swsh5.effect: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

swsh5.name: Salazzle
swsh5.effect: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

swsh5.name: Sizzlipede
swsh5.effect: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

swsh5.name: Centiskorch
swsh5.effect: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

swsh5.name: Horsea
swsh5.effect: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

swsh5.name: Seadra
swsh5.effect: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

swsh5.name: Kingdra
swsh5.effect: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

swsh5.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
swsh5.effect: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

swsh5.name: Galarian Mr. Rime
swsh5.effect: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

swsh5.name: Remoraid
swsh5.effect: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

swsh5.name: Octillery
swsh5.effect: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

swsh5.name: Corphish
swsh5.effect: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

swsh5.name: Crawdaunt
swsh5.effect: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

swsh5.name: Empoleon V
swsh5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Frillish
swsh5.effect: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

swsh5.name: Jellicent
swsh5.effect: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

swsh5.name: Bruxish
swsh5.effect: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

swsh5.name: Electabuzz
swsh5.effect: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

swsh5.name: Electivire
swsh5.effect: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

swsh5.name: Shinx
swsh5.effect: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

swsh5.name: Luxio
swsh5.effect: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

swsh5.name: Luxray
swsh5.effect: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

swsh5.name: Pachirisu
swsh5.effect: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

swsh5.name: Tapu Koko V
swsh5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Tapu Koko VMAX
swsh5.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Yamper
swsh5.effect: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

swsh5.name: Boltund
swsh5.effect: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

swsh5.name: Galarian Slowpoke
swsh5.effect: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

swsh5.name: Spoink
swsh5.effect: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

swsh5.name: Grumpig
swsh5.effect: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

swsh5.name: Baltoy
swsh5.effect: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

swsh5.name: Claydol
swsh5.effect: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

swsh5.name: Chimecho
swsh5.effect: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

swsh5.name: Espurr
swsh5.effect: There's enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can't be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

swsh5.name: Meowstic
swsh5.effect: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

swsh5.name: Mimikyu V
swsh5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Necrozma V
swsh5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Dottler
swsh5.effect: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

swsh5.name: Orbeetle
swsh5.effect: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

swsh5.name: Mankey
swsh5.effect: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

swsh5.name: Primeape
swsh5.effect: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

swsh5.name: Onix
swsh5.effect: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

swsh5.name: Cubone
swsh5.effect: It wears its mother's skull on its head, so no one knows what its bare face looks like. However, it's clear that it's always crying.

swsh5.name: Marowak
swsh5.effect: They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.

swsh5.name: Gligar
swsh5.effect: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

swsh5.name: Gliscor
swsh5.effect: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

swsh5.name: Timburr
swsh5.effect: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

swsh5.name: Gurdurr
swsh5.effect: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there's skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

swsh5.name: Conkeldurr
swsh5.effect: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

swsh5.name: Mienfoo
swsh5.effect: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

swsh5.name: Mienshao
swsh5.effect: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you're in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!

swsh5.name: Rolycoly
swsh5.effect: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

swsh5.name: Carkol
swsh5.effect: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

swsh5.name: Coalossal
swsh5.effect: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

swsh5.name: Silicobra
swsh5.effect: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

swsh5.name: Sandaconda
swsh5.effect: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

swsh5.name: Falinks
swsh5.effect: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

swsh5.name: Stonjourner
swsh5.effect: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

swsh5.name: Single Strike Urshifu V
swsh5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Single Strike Urshifu VMAX
swsh5.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Rapid Strike Urshifu V
swsh5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Rapid Strike Urshifu VMAX
swsh5.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Zubat
swsh5.effect: Their skin is so thin that they'll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another's bodies.

swsh5.name: Golbat
swsh5.effect: They can suck down over 10 ounces of blood in one go. They have been known to drink so much blood that they can no longer fly.

swsh5.name: Crobat
swsh5.effect: It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can't drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.

swsh5.name: Galarian Slowbro
swsh5.effect: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

swsh5.name: Murkrow
swsh5.effect: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

swsh5.name: Honchkrow
swsh5.effect: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

swsh5.name: Houndour
swsh5.effect: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

swsh5.name: Houndoom
swsh5.effect: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

swsh5.name: Tyranitar V
swsh5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Morpeko
swsh5.effect: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

swsh5.name: Steelix
swsh5.effect: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

swsh5.name: Mawile
swsh5.effect: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

swsh5.name: Bronzor
swsh5.effect: Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surface reflect the truth, according to common lore. Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.

swsh5.name: Bronzong
swsh5.effect: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

swsh5.name: Pawniard
swsh5.effect: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

swsh5.name: Bisharp
swsh5.effect: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

swsh5.name: Honedge
swsh5.effect: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

swsh5.name: Doublade
swsh5.effect: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

swsh5.name: Aegislash
swsh5.effect: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

swsh5.name: Aegislash
swsh5.effect: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

swsh5.name: Corviknight V
swsh5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Corviknight VMAX
swsh5.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Spearow
swsh5.effect: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

swsh5.name: Fearow
swsh5.effect: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

swsh5.name: Lickitung
swsh5.effect: It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it's really clean is…questionable.

swsh5.name: Lickilicky
swsh5.effect: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.

swsh5.name: Glameow
swsh5.effect: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

swsh5.name: Purugly
swsh5.effect: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

swsh5.name: Stoutland V
swsh5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh5.name: Bouffalant
swsh5.effect: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

swsh5.name: Drampa
swsh5.effect: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

swsh5.name: Indeedee
swsh5.effect: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

swsh5.name: Bruno
swsh5.effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, draw 7 cards instead. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh5.name: Camping Gear
swsh5.effect: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. Your turn ends. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh5.name: Cheryl
swsh5.effect: Heal all damage from each of your Evolution Pokémon. If you do, discard all Energy from the Pokémon that were healed in this way. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh5.name: Energy Recycler
swsh5.effect: Shuffle up to 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh5.name: Escape Rope
swsh5.effect: Each player switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. Your opponent switches first. (If a player does not have a Benched Pokémon, they don't switch Pokémon.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh5.effect: Shuffle up to 2 Single Strike Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
