swsh6.name: Weedle
swsh6.effect: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

swsh6.name: Kakuna
swsh6.effect: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

swsh6.name: Beedrill
swsh6.effect: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

swsh6.name: Ledyba
swsh6.effect: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

swsh6.name: Ledian
swsh6.effect: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

swsh6.name: Heracross
swsh6.effect: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it's not that good at flying.

swsh6.name: Celebi V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Celebi VMAX
swsh6.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Snover
swsh6.effect: The berries that grow around its belly are like ice pops. Galarian Darumaka absolutely love these berries.

swsh6.name: Abomasnow
swsh6.effect: This Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.

swsh6.name: Deerling
swsh6.effect: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

swsh6.name: Sawsbuck
swsh6.effect: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

swsh6.name: Bounsweet
swsh6.effect: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

swsh6.name: Steenee
swsh6.effect: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

swsh6.name: Tsareena
swsh6.effect: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon's legs leaves a wound in the opponent's body and soul that will never heal.

swsh6.name: Grookey
swsh6.effect: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

swsh6.name: Thwackey
swsh6.effect: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.

swsh6.name: Rillaboom
swsh6.effect: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

swsh6.name: Zarude
swsh6.effect: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

swsh6.name: Blaziken V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Blaziken VMAX
swsh6.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Castform Sunny Form
swsh6.effect: Castform changes to this form when it basks in bright sunlight. When you touch its glowing skin, it feels all dried out!

swsh6.name: Larvesta
swsh6.effect: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

swsh6.name: Volcarona
swsh6.effect: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

swsh6.name: Volcanion V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Scorbunny
swsh6.effect: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

swsh6.name: Raboot
swsh6.effect: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

swsh6.name: Cinderace
swsh6.effect: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

swsh6.name: Lapras
swsh6.effect: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

swsh6.name: Sneasel
swsh6.effect: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

swsh6.name: Weavile
swsh6.effect: With its claws, it leaves behind signs for its friends to find. The number of distinct signs is said to be over 500.

swsh6.name: Delibird
swsh6.effect: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.

swsh6.name: Castform Rainy Form
swsh6.effect: This is Castform's form when pelted by rain. In an experiment where it was placed in a shower, this Pokémon didn't change to this form.

swsh6.name: Castform Snowy Form
swsh6.effect: This is Castform's form when caught in a hailstorm. Its whole body is chilled, and its skin is partially frozen!

swsh6.name: Snorunt
swsh6.effect: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as −150 degrees Fahrenheit.

swsh6.name: Froslass
swsh6.effect: It spits out cold air of nearly −60 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozen prey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.

swsh6.name: Spheal
swsh6.effect: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

swsh6.name: Sealeo
swsh6.effect: Be it Spheal or a Poké Ball, it will spin any round object on its nose with the greatest of ease.

swsh6.name: Walrein
swsh6.effect: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.

swsh6.name: Tapu Fini
swsh6.effect: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

swsh6.name: Sobble
swsh6.effect: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

swsh6.name: Drizzile
swsh6.effect: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

swsh6.name: Inteleon
swsh6.effect: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

swsh6.name: Rapid Strike Urshifu
swsh6.effect: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

swsh6.name: Ice Rider Calyrex V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Ice Rider Calyrex VMAX
swsh6.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Mareep
swsh6.effect: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

swsh6.name: Flaaffy
swsh6.effect: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

swsh6.name: Ampharos
swsh6.effect: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

swsh6.name: Blitzle
swsh6.effect: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

swsh6.name: Zebstrika
swsh6.effect: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

swsh6.name: Thundurus
swsh6.effect: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

swsh6.name: Zeraora V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Galarian Slowpoke
swsh6.effect: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

swsh6.name: Gastly
swsh6.effect: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.

swsh6.name: Haunter
swsh6.effect: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

swsh6.name: Gengar
swsh6.effect: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

swsh6.name: Galarian Articuno V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Ralts
swsh6.effect: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

swsh6.name: Kirlia
swsh6.effect: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

swsh6.name: Gardevoir
swsh6.effect: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

swsh6.name: Shuppet
swsh6.effect: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

swsh6.name: Banette
swsh6.effect: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

swsh6.name: Cresselia
swsh6.effect: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

swsh6.name: Golett
swsh6.effect: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

swsh6.name: Golurk
swsh6.effect: There's a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn't been proven.

swsh6.name: Swirlix
swsh6.effect: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix's fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

swsh6.name: Slurpuff
swsh6.effect: Slurpuff's fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

swsh6.name: Inkay
swsh6.effect: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

swsh6.name: Malamar
swsh6.effect: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

swsh6.name: Hatenna
swsh6.effect: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

swsh6.name: Hattrem
swsh6.effect: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

swsh6.name: Hatterene
swsh6.effect: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

swsh6.name: Shadow Rider Calyrex V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Shadow Rider Calyrex VMAX
swsh6.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Diglett
swsh6.effect: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

swsh6.name: Dugtrio
swsh6.effect: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.

swsh6.name: Galarian Farfetch'd
swsh6.effect: The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the Galar region. Farfetch'd that adapted to these stalks took on a unique form.

swsh6.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
swsh6.effect: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

swsh6.name: Galarian Zapdos V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Gallade
swsh6.effect: Sharply attuned to others' wishes for help, this Pokémon seeks out those in need and aids them in battle.

swsh6.name: Galarian Yamask
swsh6.effect: It's said that this Pokémon was formed when an ancient clay tablet was drawn to a vengeful spirit.

swsh6.name: Galarian Runerigus
swsh6.effect: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

swsh6.name: Crabrawler
swsh6.effect: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

swsh6.name: Crabominable
swsh6.effect: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

swsh6.name: Rockruff
swsh6.effect: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

swsh6.name: Lycanroc
swsh6.effect: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

swsh6.name: Passimian
swsh6.effect: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

swsh6.name: Sandaconda V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Sandaconda VMAX
swsh6.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Clobbopus
swsh6.effect: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

swsh6.name: Grapploct
swsh6.effect: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

swsh6.name: Kubfu
swsh6.effect: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

swsh6.name: Koffing
swsh6.effect: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

swsh6.name: Weezing
swsh6.effect: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

swsh6.name: Galarian Weezing
swsh6.effect: Long ago, during a time when droves of factories fouled the air with pollution, Weezing changed into this form for some reason.

swsh6.name: Galarian Moltres V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Galarian Slowking
swsh6.effect: While chanting strange spells, this Pokémon combines its internal toxins with what it's eaten, creating strange potions.

swsh6.name: Galarian Slowking V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Galarian Slowking VMAX
swsh6.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Qwilfish
swsh6.effect: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

swsh6.name: Seviper
swsh6.effect: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It's Zangoose's archrival.

swsh6.name: Spiritomb
swsh6.effect: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

swsh6.name: Liepard V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Venipede
swsh6.effect: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

swsh6.name: Whirlipede
swsh6.effect: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

swsh6.name: Scolipede
swsh6.effect: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

swsh6.name: Single Strike Urshifu
swsh6.effect: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

swsh6.name: Aron
swsh6.effect: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

swsh6.name: Lairon
swsh6.effect: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

swsh6.name: Aggron
swsh6.effect: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

swsh6.name: Metagross V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Metagross VMAX
swsh6.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Cobalion
swsh6.effect: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

swsh6.name: Tauros
swsh6.effect: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

swsh6.name: Porygon
swsh6.effect: It was built 20 years ago by scientists who dreamed of exploring space. Their dreams have yet to come true.

swsh6.name: Porygon2
swsh6.effect: Even though it doesn't die in the vacuum of space, it can't move around very well in zero gravity.

swsh6.name: Porygon-Z
swsh6.effect: A faulty update was added to its programming. Its behavior is noticeably strange, so the experiment may have been a failure.

swsh6.name: Blissey V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Zangoose
swsh6.effect: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

swsh6.name: Castform
swsh6.effect: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

swsh6.name: Kecleon
swsh6.effect: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

swsh6.name: Shaymin
swsh6.effect: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

swsh6.name: Tornadus V
swsh6.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Tornadus VMAX
swsh6.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh6.name: Furfrou
swsh6.effect: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

swsh6.name: Skwovet
swsh6.effect: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

swsh6.name: Greedent
swsh6.effect: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

swsh6.name: Agatha
swsh6.effect: Move up to 3 damage counters from your Active Pokémon to your opponent's Active Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh6.name: Avery
swsh6.effect: Draw 3 cards. If you drew any cards in this way, your opponent discards Pokémon from their Bench until they have 3. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh6.name: Brawly
swsh6.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Rapid Strike Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh6.name: Caitlin
swsh6.effect: Put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, draw that many cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh6.name: Crushing Gloves
swsh6.effect: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. The attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Metal Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh6.name: Doctor
swsh6.effect: Draw 2 cards. If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon VMAX, draw 2 more cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh6.name: Dyna Tree Hill
swsh6.effect: Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) can't be healed. This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

swsh6.name: Echoing Horn
swsh6.effect: Put a Basic Pokémon from your opponent's discard pile onto their Bench. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh6.name: Path to the Peak

Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

swsh6.name: Peonia
swsh6.effect: Put up to 3 Prize cards into your hand. Then, for each Prize card you put into your hand in this way, put a card from your hand face down as a Prize card. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh6.name: Peony
swsh6.effect: Discard your hand and search your deck for up to 2 Trainer cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh6.name: Rapid Strike Scroll of the Skies
swsh6.effect: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. The Rapid Strike Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh6.name: Rugged Helmet
swsh6.effect: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if it is Knocked Out), put an Energy attached to the Attacking Pokémon into your opponent's hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh6.effect: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. The Single Strike Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh6.name: Welcoming Lantern
swsh6.effect: Put a Single Strike Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh6.name: Impact Energy
swsh6.effect: This card can only be attached to a Single Strike Pokémon. If this card is attached to anything other than a Single Strike Pokémon, discard this card. As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. The Pokémon this card is attached to can't be Poisoned, and if it is already Poisoned, it recovers from that Special Condition.

swsh6.name: Lucky Energy
swsh6.effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy. If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if it is Knocked Out), draw a card.

swsh6.name: Spiral Energy
swsh6.effect: This card can only be attached to a Rapid Strike Pokémon. If this card is attached to anything other than a Rapid Strike Pokémon, discard this card. As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. The Pokémon this card is attached to can't be Paralyzed, and if it is already Paralyzed, it recovers from that Special Condition.

swsh6.name: Electrode
swsh6.effect: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

swsh6.name: Bronzong
swsh6.effect: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

swsh6.name: Snorlax
swsh6.effect: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

swsh6.name: Echoing Horn
swsh6.effect: Put a Basic Pokémon from your opponent's discard pile onto their Bench. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh6.name: Fan of Waves
swsh6.effect: Put a Special Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon on the bottom of their deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh6.name: Fog Crystal
swsh6.effect: Search your deck for a Psychic Energy card or a Basic Psychic Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh6.name: Rugged Helmet
swsh6.effect: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if it is Knocked Out), put an Energy attached to the Attacking Pokémon into your opponent's hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh6.name: Urn of Vitality
swsh6.effect: Shuffle up to 2 Single Strike Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh6.name: Welcoming Lantern
swsh6.effect: Put a Single Strike Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh7.name: Pinsir
swsh7.effect: Although it's tough, it can't handle cold well. When night falls, it buries itself in leafage and sleeps.

swsh7.name: Hoppip
swsh7.effect: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

swsh7.name: Skiploom
swsh7.effect: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

swsh7.name: Jumpluff
swsh7.effect: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

swsh7.name: Seedot
swsh7.effect: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

swsh7.name: Tropius
swsh7.effect: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

swsh7.name: Leafeon V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Leafeon VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Petilil
swsh7.effect: They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.

swsh7.name: Lilligant
swsh7.effect: It's well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.

swsh7.name: Dwebble
swsh7.effect: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

swsh7.name: Crustle
swsh7.effect: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.

swsh7.name: Trevenant V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Trevenant VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Gossifleur
swsh7.effect: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

swsh7.name: Eldegoss
swsh7.effect: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

swsh7.name: Applin
swsh7.effect: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

swsh7.name: Flareon VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Entei
swsh7.effect: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

swsh7.name: Victini
swsh7.effect: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

swsh7.name: Volcarona V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Litleo
swsh7.effect: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

swsh7.name: Pyroar
swsh7.effect: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

swsh7.name: Psyduck
swsh7.effect: It has been found that its brain cells are 10 times more active when Psyduck is experiencing a headache.

swsh7.name: Golduck
swsh7.effect: A professional swimmer, it can continue swimming for two days straight by waving its long tail skillfully.

swsh7.name: Tentacool
swsh7.effect: Its body is 99% water. The remaining 1% contains the organ that makes its poison.

swsh7.name: Tentacruel
swsh7.effect: It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it's a warning sign.

swsh7.name: Gyarados V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Gyarados VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Vaporeon VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Suicune V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Lotad
swsh7.effect: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

swsh7.name: Lombre
swsh7.effect: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

swsh7.name: Ludicolo
swsh7.effect: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

swsh7.name: Carvanha
swsh7.effect: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

swsh7.name: Sharpedo
swsh7.effect: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

swsh7.name: Feebas
swsh7.effect: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

swsh7.name: Milotic
swsh7.effect: It's said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you're feeling.

swsh7.name: Luvdisc
swsh7.effect: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

swsh7.name: Glaceon V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Glaceon VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Tympole
swsh7.effect: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

swsh7.name: Cryogonal
swsh7.effect: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.

swsh7.name: Bergmite
swsh7.effect: This Pokémon lives in areas of frigid cold. It secures itself to the back of an Avalugg by freezing its feet in place.

swsh7.name: Avalugg
swsh7.effect: As Avalugg moves about during the day, the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon's body returns to a pristine state overnight.

swsh7.name: Wishiwashi
swsh7.effect: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

swsh7.name: Eiscue
swsh7.effect: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

swsh7.name: Arctovish V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Pikachu
swsh7.effect: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

swsh7.name: Raichu
swsh7.effect: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.

swsh7.name: Jolteon VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Chinchou
swsh7.effect: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

swsh7.name: Lanturn
swsh7.effect: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

swsh7.name: Mareep
swsh7.effect: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

swsh7.name: Flaaffy
swsh7.effect: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

swsh7.name: Ampharos
swsh7.effect: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

swsh7.name: Emolga
swsh7.effect: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

swsh7.name: Dracozolt V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Dracozolt VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Regieleki
swsh7.effect: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar's electricity.

swsh7.name: Drowzee
swsh7.effect: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

swsh7.name: Hypno
swsh7.effect: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

swsh7.name: Galarian Articuno
swsh7.effect: Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires beams that can immobilize opponents as if they had been frozen solid.

swsh7.name: Espeon V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Espeon VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Wobbuffet
swsh7.effect: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

swsh7.name: Sableye
swsh7.effect: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

swsh7.name: Woobat
swsh7.effect: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

swsh7.name: Swoobat
swsh7.effect: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

swsh7.name: Golurk V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Flabébé
swsh7.effect: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

swsh7.name: Floette
swsh7.effect: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

swsh7.name: Florges
swsh7.effect: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

swsh7.name: Sylveon V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Sylveon VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Pumpkaboo
swsh7.effect: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

swsh7.name: Gourgeist
swsh7.effect: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

swsh7.name: Cutiefly
swsh7.effect: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

swsh7.name: Ribombee
swsh7.effect: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

swsh7.name: Marshadow
swsh7.effect: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.

swsh7.name: Hitmonchan
swsh7.effect: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

swsh7.name: Galarian Zapdos
swsh7.effect: One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.

swsh7.name: Medicham V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Hippopotas
swsh7.effect: This Pokémon is active during the day and passes the cold desert nights burrowed snugly into the sand.

swsh7.name: Hippowdon
swsh7.effect: When roused to violence by its rage, it spews out the quantities of sand it has swallowed and whips up a sandstorm.

swsh7.name: Roggenrola
swsh7.effect: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

swsh7.name: Boldore
swsh7.effect: It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it's facing.

swsh7.name: Gigalith
swsh7.effect: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

swsh7.name: Palpitoad
swsh7.effect: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

swsh7.name: Seismitoad
swsh7.effect: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

swsh7.name: Lycanroc V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Lycanroc VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Galarian Moltres
swsh7.effect: The sinister aura that blazes like molten fire around this Pokémon is what inspired the name Moltres.

swsh7.name: Umbreon V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Umbreon VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Nuzleaf
swsh7.effect: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf's grass flute fills listeners with dread.

swsh7.name: Shiftry
swsh7.effect: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

swsh7.name: Scraggy
swsh7.effect: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

swsh7.name: Scrafty
swsh7.effect: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

swsh7.name: Garbodor V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Garbodor VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Zorua
swsh7.effect: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

swsh7.name: Zoroark
swsh7.effect: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

swsh7.name: Nickit
swsh7.effect: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

swsh7.name: Thievul
swsh7.effect: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

swsh7.name: Altaria
swsh7.effect: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

swsh7.name: Bagon
swsh7.effect: Some theories suggest that its behavior of forcefully bashing its head into things stimulates cells that affect its evolution.

swsh7.name: Shelgon
swsh7.effect: Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will be able to fly.

swsh7.name: Salamence
swsh7.effect: Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart's desire—wings.

swsh7.name: Rayquaza V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Rayquaza VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Dialga
swsh7.effect: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

swsh7.name: Deino
swsh7.effect: Because it can't see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

swsh7.name: Zweilous
swsh7.effect: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

swsh7.name: Hydreigon
swsh7.effect: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won't slow until their target goes down.

swsh7.name: Kyurem
swsh7.effect: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

swsh7.name: Noivern V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Zygarde
swsh7.effect: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

swsh7.name: Drampa
swsh7.effect: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

swsh7.name: Flapple
swsh7.effect: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

swsh7.name: Appletun
swsh7.effect: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

swsh7.name: Duraludon V
swsh7.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Duraludon VMAX
swsh7.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh7.name: Regidrago
swsh7.effect: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

swsh7.name: Eevee
swsh7.effect: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

swsh7.name: Teddiursa
swsh7.effect: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

swsh7.name: Ursaring
swsh7.effect: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

swsh7.name: Smeargle
swsh7.effect: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

swsh7.name: Slakoth
swsh7.effect: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

swsh7.name: Vigoroth
swsh7.effect: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

swsh7.name: Slaking
swsh7.effect: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

swsh7.name: Swablu
swsh7.effect: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

swsh7.name: Lillipup
swsh7.effect: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it's intelligent, obedient to its Trainer's commands, and easy to raise.

swsh7.name: Herdier
swsh7.effect: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.

swsh7.name: Stoutland
swsh7.effect: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.

swsh7.name: Rufflet
swsh7.effect: A combative Pokémon, it's ready to pick a fight with anyone. It has talons that can crush hard berries.

swsh7.name: Braviary
swsh7.effect: Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and belligerent, it's Corviknight that's taken the role of transportation in Galar.

swsh7.name: Fletchling
swsh7.effect: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

swsh7.name: Fletchinder
swsh7.effect: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

swsh7.name: Talonflame
swsh7.effect: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

swsh7.name: Aroma Lady
swsh7.effect: Draw 2 cards. If you do, your Active Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh7.name: Boost Shake
swsh7.effect: Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. You can use this card during your first turn or on a Pokémon that was put into play this turn. Your turn ends. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh7.name: Copycat
swsh7.effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a card for each card in your opponent's hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh7.name: Crystal Cave
swsh7.effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may heal 30 damage from each of their Metal Pokémon and Dragon Pokémon.

swsh7.name: Digging Gloves
swsh7.effect: The attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Fighting Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh7.name: Dream Ball
swsh7.effect: You can play this card only if you took it as a face-down Prize card, before you put it into your hand. Search your deck for a Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh7.name: Elemental Badge
swsh7.effect: If the Pokémon V this card is attached to has "Vaporeon," "Jolteon," or "Flareon" in its name, its attacks cost Colorless less. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh7.name: Full Face Guard
swsh7.effect: If the Pokémon this card is attached to has no Abilities, it takes 20 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh7.name: Gordie
swsh7.effect: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Energy cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh7.name: Lucky Ice Pop
swsh7.effect: Heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon. If you healed any damage in this way, flip a coin. If heads, put this Lucky Ice Pop into your hand instead of the discard pile. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh7.name: Moon & Sun Badge
swsh7.effect: If the Pokémon V this card is attached to has "Espeon" or "Umbreon" in its name, whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to that Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh7.name: Raihan
swsh7.effect: You can play this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn. Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh7.name: Rapid Strike Scroll of the Flying Dragon
swsh7.effect: The Rapid Strike Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh7.name: Rescue Carrier
swsh7.effect: Put up to 2 Pokémon, each with 90 HP or less, from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh7.name: Ribbon Badge
swsh7.effect: If the Pokémon V this card is attached to has "Sylveon" in its name and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh7.name: Rubber Gloves
swsh7.effect: The attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Lightning Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh7.name: Shopping Center
swsh7.effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may put a Pokémon Tool attached to 1 of their Pokémon into their hand.

swsh7.name: Single Strike Scroll of the Fanged Dragon
swsh7.effect: The Single Strike Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh7.name: Snow Leaf Badge
swsh7.effect: If the Pokémon V this card is attached to has "Leafeon" or "Glaceon" in its name, it has no Retreat Cost and no Weakness. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh7.name: Spirit Mask
swsh7.effect: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if it is Knocked Out), your opponent discards a card from their hand. swsh8.name: Toxtricity
swsh8.effect: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

swsh8.name: Morpeko
swsh8.effect: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

swsh8.name: Jigglypuff
swsh8.effect: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

swsh8.name: Wigglytuff
swsh8.effect: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

swsh8.name: Jynx
swsh8.effect: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

swsh8.name: Mew V
swsh8.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh8.name: Mew VMAX
swsh8.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh8.name: Snubbull
swsh8.effect: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

swsh8.name: Granbull
swsh8.effect: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

swsh8.name: Galarian Corsola
swsh8.effect: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others' life-force through its branches.

swsh8.name: Galarian Cursola
swsh8.effect: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

swsh8.name: Mawile
swsh8.effect: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

swsh8.name: Deoxys
swsh8.effect: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

swsh8.name: Munna
swsh8.effect: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.

swsh8.name: Musharna
swsh8.effect: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

swsh8.name: Sigilyph
swsh8.effect: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

swsh8.name: Meloetta
swsh8.effect: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

swsh8.name: Sandygast
swsh8.effect: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

swsh8.name: Palossand
swsh8.effect: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

swsh8.name: Indeedee
swsh8.effect: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

swsh8.name: Dreepy
swsh8.effect: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

swsh8.name: Drakloak
swsh8.effect: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it'll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

swsh8.name: Dragapult
swsh8.effect: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

swsh8.name: Sandshrew
swsh8.effect: When its skin gets wrinkled from moisture, it heads for a volcano. It lies flat on a spot with a lot of geothermal heat and dries itself out.

swsh8.name: Sandslash
swsh8.effect: Thanks to its thick claws, it's good at climbing trees. There are plenty of Sandslash that park themselves in trees and go right to sleep.

swsh8.name: Mankey
swsh8.effect: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

swsh8.name: Primeape
swsh8.effect: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

swsh8.name: Geodude
swsh8.effect: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.

swsh8.name: Graveler
swsh8.effect: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

swsh8.name: Golem
swsh8.effect: It detonates its own body. The power from that explosion can propel it up steep mountain paths with amazing speed.

swsh8.name: Onix
swsh8.effect: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

swsh8.name: Steelix
swsh8.effect: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

swsh8.name: Gligar
swsh8.effect: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

swsh8.name: Gliscor
swsh8.effect: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

swsh8.name: Makuhita
swsh8.effect: There's a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

swsh8.name: Hariyama
swsh8.effect: Hariyama that are big and fat aren't necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

swsh8.name: Baltoy
swsh8.effect: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

swsh8.name: Claydol
swsh8.effect: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

swsh8.name: Lucario V
swsh8.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh8.name: Drilbur
swsh8.effect: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

swsh8.name: Landorus
swsh8.effect: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

swsh8.name: Pancham
swsh8.effect: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.

swsh8.name: Stufful
swsh8.effect: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

swsh8.name: Bewear
swsh8.effect: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

swsh8.name: Clobbopus
swsh8.effect: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

swsh8.name: Grapploct
swsh8.effect: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

swsh8.name: Falinks
swsh8.effect: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

swsh8.name: Falinks
swsh8.effect: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

swsh8.name: Gengar V
swsh8.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh8.name: Gengar VMAX
swsh8.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh8.name: Tyranitar V
swsh8.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh8.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
swsh8.effect: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

swsh8.name: Galarian Linoone
swsh8.effect: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

swsh8.name: Galarian Obstagoon
swsh8.effect: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

swsh8.name: Carvanha
swsh8.effect: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

swsh8.name: Sharpedo
swsh8.effect: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

swsh8.name: Absol
swsh8.effect: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

swsh8.name: Croagunk
swsh8.effect: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.

swsh8.name: Toxicroak
swsh8.effect: It booms out a victory croak when its prey goes down in defeat. This Pokémon and Seismitoad are related species.

swsh8.name: Darkrai
swsh8.effect: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

swsh8.name: Trubbish
swsh8.effect: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

swsh8.name: Garbodor
swsh8.effect: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

swsh8.name: Zorua
swsh8.effect: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

swsh8.name: Zoroark
swsh8.effect: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

swsh8.name: Vullaby
swsh8.effect: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

swsh8.name: Mandibuzz
swsh8.effect: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

swsh8.name: Pangoro
swsh8.effect: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

swsh8.name: Yveltal
swsh8.effect: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

swsh8.name: Impidimp
swsh8.effect: It sneaks into people's homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

swsh8.name: Morgrem
swsh8.effect: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

swsh8.name: Grimmsnarl
swsh8.effect: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

swsh8.name: Morpeko
swsh8.effect: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

swsh8.name: Galarian Meowth
swsh8.effect: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

swsh8.name: Galarian Perrserker
swsh8.effect: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

swsh8.name: Skarmory
swsh8.effect: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

swsh8.name: Excadrill
swsh8.effect: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

swsh8.name: Durant
swsh8.effect: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

swsh8.name: Genesect V
swsh8.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh8.name: Klefki
swsh8.effect: Long ago it lived in mines, but once the minerals that make up its diet became scarcer, Klefki began appearing in human settlements.

swsh8.name: Togedemaru
swsh8.effect: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

swsh8.name: Meltan
swsh8.effect: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

swsh8.name: Melmetal
swsh8.effect: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

swsh8.name: Corviknight
swsh8.effect: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.

swsh8.name: Cufant
swsh8.effect: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

swsh8.name: Copperajah
swsh8.effect: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

swsh8.name: Latias
swsh8.effect: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

swsh8.name: Latios
swsh8.effect: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

swsh8.name: Goomy
swsh8.effect: Their horns are powerful sensors. As soon as Goomy pick up any sign of enemies, they go into hiding. This is how they've survived.

swsh8.name: Sliggoo
swsh8.effect: The lump on its back contains its tiny brain. It thinks only of food and escaping its enemies.

swsh8.name: Goodra
swsh8.effect: Its form of offense is forcefully stretching out its horns. The strikes land 100 times harder than any blow from a heavyweight boxer.

swsh8.name: Turtonator
swsh8.effect: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

swsh8.name: Meowth
swsh8.effect: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn't get along with Galarian Meowth.

swsh8.name: Persian
swsh8.effect: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

swsh8.name: Dodrio V
swsh8.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh8.name: Chansey
swsh8.effect: Because the eggs on their bellies have been overharvested by people in the past, the Chansey population remains very small.

swsh8.name: Blissey
swsh8.effect: This Pokémon is overflowing with love. Only Chansey that share a strong bond with their Trainer can evolve, so people say.

swsh8.name: Kangaskhan
swsh8.effect: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

swsh8.name: Eevee
swsh8.effect: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

swsh8.name: Snorlax
swsh8.effect: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

swsh8.name: Dunsparce
swsh8.effect: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

swsh8.name: Stantler
swsh8.effect: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

swsh8.name: Smeargle
swsh8.effect: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

swsh8.name: Skitty
swsh8.effect: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

swsh8.name: Delcatty
swsh8.effect: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

swsh8.name: Buneary
swsh8.effect: The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it can launch a swift counterattack if it's attacked by an enemy.

swsh8.name: Lopunny
swsh8.effect: It's notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.

swsh8.name: Bunnelby
swsh8.effect: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

swsh8.name: Diggersby
swsh8.effect: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

swsh8.name: Hawlucha
swsh8.effect: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

swsh8.name: Greedent V
swsh8.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh8.name: Greedent VMAX
swsh8.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh8.name: Rookidee
swsh8.effect: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

swsh8.name: Corvisquire
swsh8.effect: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.

swsh8.name: Wooloo
swsh8.effect: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

swsh8.name: Wooloo
swsh8.effect: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

swsh8.name: Dubwool
swsh8.effect: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
