swsh8.effect: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

swsh8.name: Power Tablet
swsh8.effect: During this turn, your Fusion Strike Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh8.name: Training Court
swsh8.effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may put a basic Energy card from their discard pile into their hand.

swsh9.name: Exeggcute
swsh9.effect: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

swsh9.name: Exeggutor
swsh9.effect: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

swsh9.name: Shroomish
swsh9.effect: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

swsh9.name: Breloom
swsh9.effect: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

swsh9.name: Tropius
swsh9.effect: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

swsh9.name: Turtwig
swsh9.effect: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

swsh9.name: Grotle
swsh9.effect: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

swsh9.name: Torterra
swsh9.effect: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

swsh9.name: Burmy
swsh9.effect: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

swsh9.name: Wormadam
swsh9.effect: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

swsh9.name: Mothim
swsh9.effect: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

swsh9.name: Cherubi
swsh9.effect: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

swsh9.name: Shaymin V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Shaymin VSTAR
swsh9.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Karrablast
swsh9.effect: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

swsh9.name: Zarude V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Charizard V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Charizard VSTAR
swsh9.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Magmar
swsh9.effect: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

swsh9.name: Magmortar
swsh9.effect: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

swsh9.name: Moltres
swsh9.effect: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

swsh9.name: Entei V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Torkoal
swsh9.effect: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

swsh9.name: Chimchar
swsh9.effect: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

swsh9.name: Monferno
swsh9.effect: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

swsh9.name: Infernape
swsh9.effect: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

swsh9.name: Simisear V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Kingler V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Kingler VMAX
swsh9.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Staryu
swsh9.effect: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

swsh9.name: Lapras
swsh9.effect: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

swsh9.name: Corphish
swsh9.effect: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

swsh9.name: Crawdaunt
swsh9.effect: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

swsh9.name: Snorunt
swsh9.effect: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.

swsh9.name: Piplup
swsh9.effect: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

swsh9.name: Prinplup
swsh9.effect: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

swsh9.name: Empoleon
swsh9.effect: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

swsh9.name: Buizel
swsh9.effect: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

swsh9.name: Floatzel
swsh9.effect: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

swsh9.name: Lumineon V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Manaphy
swsh9.effect: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

swsh9.name: Cubchoo
swsh9.effect: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

swsh9.name: Beartic
swsh9.effect: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

swsh9.name: Eiscue
swsh9.effect: The hair on its head connects to the surface of its brain. When this Pokémon has something on its mind, its hair chills the air around it.

swsh9.name: Raichu V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Electabuzz
swsh9.effect: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

swsh9.name: Electivire
swsh9.effect: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

swsh9.name: Raikou V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Shinx
swsh9.effect: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

swsh9.name: Luxio
swsh9.effect: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

swsh9.name: Luxray
swsh9.effect: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

swsh9.name: Pachirisu
swsh9.effect: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

swsh9.name: Clefairy
swsh9.effect: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

swsh9.name: Clefable
swsh9.effect: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

swsh9.name: Starmie
swsh9.effect: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

swsh9.name: Mewtwo
swsh9.effect: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

swsh9.name: Granbull V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Baltoy
swsh9.effect: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

swsh9.name: Claydol
swsh9.effect: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

swsh9.name: Duskull
swsh9.effect: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

swsh9.name: Dusclops
swsh9.effect: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

swsh9.name: Dusknoir
swsh9.effect: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

swsh9.name: Chimecho
swsh9.effect: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

swsh9.name: Whimsicott V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Whimsicott VSTAR
swsh9.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Sigilyph
swsh9.effect: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

swsh9.name: Dedenne
swsh9.effect: Since Dedenne can't generate as much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

swsh9.name: Mimikyu V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Mimikyu VMAX
swsh9.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Milcery
swsh9.effect: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

swsh9.name: Alcremie
swsh9.effect: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

swsh9.name: Hitmontop
swsh9.effect: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

swsh9.name: Nosepass
swsh9.effect: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

swsh9.name: Trapinch
swsh9.effect: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

swsh9.name: Vibrava
swsh9.effect: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

swsh9.name: Flygon
swsh9.effect: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

swsh9.name: Wormadam
swsh9.effect: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

swsh9.name: Riolu
swsh9.effect: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

swsh9.name: Lucario
swsh9.effect: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

swsh9.name: Throh
swsh9.effect: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh's belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer's sweat.

swsh9.name: Sawk
swsh9.effect: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it's best to quietly pass by.

swsh9.name: Golett
swsh9.effect: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

swsh9.name: Golurk
swsh9.effect: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

swsh9.name: Grimer
swsh9.effect: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

swsh9.name: Muk
swsh9.effect: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

swsh9.name: Sneasel
swsh9.effect: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

swsh9.name: Weavile
swsh9.effect: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

swsh9.name: Honchkrow V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Spiritomb
swsh9.effect: Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.

swsh9.name: Purrloin
swsh9.effect: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

swsh9.name: Liepard
swsh9.effect: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

swsh9.name: Impidimp
swsh9.effect: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

swsh9.name: Morgrem
swsh9.effect: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

swsh9.name: Grimmsnarl
swsh9.effect: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

swsh9.name: Morpeko V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Aggron V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Aggron VMAX
swsh9.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Wormadam
swsh9.effect: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

swsh9.name: Probopass
swsh9.effect: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

swsh9.name: Heatran
swsh9.effect: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

swsh9.name: Escavalier
swsh9.effect: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

swsh9.name: Klink
swsh9.effect: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

swsh9.name: Klang
swsh9.effect: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

swsh9.name: Klinklang
swsh9.effect: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

swsh9.name: Zamazenta V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Flygon V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Gible
swsh9.effect: Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sides of caves heated by geothermal energy. This way, Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.

swsh9.name: Gabite
swsh9.effect: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.

swsh9.name: Garchomp
swsh9.effect: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.

swsh9.name: Axew
swsh9.effect: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other's strength.

swsh9.name: Fraxure
swsh9.effect: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.

swsh9.name: Haxorus
swsh9.effect: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

swsh9.name: Druddigon
swsh9.effect: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

swsh9.name: Dracovish V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Farfetch'd
swsh9.effect: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

swsh9.name: Castform
swsh9.effect: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

swsh9.name: Starly
swsh9.effect: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

swsh9.name: Staravia
swsh9.effect: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

swsh9.name: Staraptor
swsh9.effect: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

swsh9.name: Bidoof
swsh9.effect: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

swsh9.name: Bibarel
swsh9.effect: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

swsh9.name: Arceus V
swsh9.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Arceus VSTAR
swsh9.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh9.name: Minccino
swsh9.effect: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

swsh9.name: Cinccino
swsh9.effect: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

swsh9.name: Tornadus
swsh9.effect: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

swsh9.name: Hawlucha
swsh9.effect: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

swsh9tg.effect: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

swsh9tg.name: Vaporeon
swsh9tg.effect: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

swsh9tg.name: Octillery
swsh9tg.effect: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

swsh9tg.name: Jolteon
swsh9tg.effect: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

swsh9tg.name: Zekrom
swsh9tg.effect: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

swsh9tg.name: Dusknoir
swsh9tg.effect: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

swsh9tg.name: Dedenne
swsh9tg.effect: Since Dedenne can't generate as much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

swsh9tg.name: Alcremie
swsh9tg.effect: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

swsh9tg.name: Ariados
swsh9tg.effect: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

swsh9tg.name: Houndoom
swsh9tg.effect: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

swsh9tg.name: Eevee
swsh9tg.effect: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

swsh9tg.name: Oranguru
swsh9tg.effect: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

cel25.name: Ho-Oh
cel25.effect: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

cel25.name: Reshiram
cel25.effect: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

cel25.name: Kyogre
cel25.effect: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cel25.name: Palkia
cel25.effect: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

cel25.name: Pikachu
cel25.effect: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

cel25.name: Zekrom
cel25.effect: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

cel25.name: Mew
cel25.effect: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

cel25.name: Xerneas
cel25.effect: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

cel25.name: Cosmog
cel25.effect: Whether or not it's a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it's in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.

cel25.name: Cosmoem
cel25.effect: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.

cel25.name: Lunala
cel25.effect: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.

cel25.name: Zacian V
cel25.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

cel25.name: Groudon
cel25.effect: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

cel25.name: Zamazenta V
cel25.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

cel25.name: Yveltal
cel25.effect: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cel25.name: Dialga
cel25.effect: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cel25.name: Solgaleo
cel25.effect: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name "the beast that devours the sun."

cel25.name: Lugia
cel25.effect: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cel25.name: Professor's Research (Professor Oak)

cel25c.name: Blastoise
cel25c.effect: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

cel25c.name: Charizard
cel25c.effect: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

cel25c.name: Dark Gyarados
cel25c.effect: Normally found only in the deep ocean, it has recently been seen in shallow waters as well.

cel25c.name: Team Magma's Groudon
cel25c.effect: This Pokémon is both Fighting Darkness type.

cel25c.name: Venusaur
cel25c.effect: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

swsh10.name: Beedrill V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Voltorb
swsh10.effect: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Electrode
swsh10.effect: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

swsh10.name: Scyther
swsh10.effect: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

swsh10.name: Scyther
swsh10.effect: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

swsh10.name: Yanma
swsh10.effect: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

swsh10.name: Yanmega
swsh10.effect: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

swsh10.name: Heracross
swsh10.effect: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

swsh10.name: Kricketot
swsh10.effect: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

swsh10.name: Kricketune
swsh10.effect: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

swsh10.name: Combee
swsh10.effect: The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.

swsh10.name: Vespiquen
swsh10.effect: It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives to defend Vespiquen.

swsh10.name: Leafeon
swsh10.effect: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

swsh10.name: Shaymin
swsh10.effect: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

swsh10.name: Petilil
swsh10.effect: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Lilligant
swsh10.effect: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Lilligant V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Lilligant VSTAR
swsh10.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Rowlet
swsh10.effect: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

swsh10.name: Dartrix
swsh10.effect: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

swsh10.name: Ponyta
swsh10.effect: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

swsh10.name: Rapidash
swsh10.effect: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

swsh10.name: Cyndaquil
swsh10.effect: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

swsh10.name: Quilava
swsh10.effect: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

swsh10.name: Heatran V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Heatran VMAX
swsh10.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Radiant Heatran
swsh10.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

swsh10.name: Psyduck
swsh10.effect: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.

swsh10.name: Golduck
swsh10.effect: This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.

swsh10.name: Starmie V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Swinub
swsh10.effect: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

swsh10.name: Piloswine
swsh10.effect: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

swsh10.name: Mamoswine
swsh10.effect: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

swsh10.name: Mantine
swsh10.effect: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

swsh10.name: Barboach
swsh10.effect: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

swsh10.name: Whiscash
swsh10.effect: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

swsh10.name: Regice
swsh10.effect: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.

swsh10.name: Glaceon
swsh10.effect: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

swsh10.name: Origin Forme Palkia V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR
swsh10.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Oshawott
swsh10.effect: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name "scalchop.".

swsh10.name: Dewott
swsh10.effect: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Basculin
swsh10.effect: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Basculegion
swsh10.effect: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

swsh10.name: Keldeo
swsh10.effect: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

swsh10.name: Radiant Greninja
swsh10.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

swsh10.name: Bergmite
swsh10.effect: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Avalugg
swsh10.effect: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

swsh10.name: Galarian Mr. Rime V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Luxray V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Regieleki
swsh10.effect: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Typhlosion
swsh10.effect: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Typhlosion V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Typhlosion VSTAR
swsh10.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Togepi
swsh10.effect: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

swsh10.name: Togetic
swsh10.effect: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

swsh10.name: Togekiss
swsh10.effect: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.

swsh10.name: Misdreavus
swsh10.effect: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

swsh10.name: Mismagius
swsh10.effect: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

swsh10.name: Ralts
swsh10.effect: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

swsh10.name: Kirlia
swsh10.effect: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

swsh10.name: Gallade
swsh10.effect: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.

swsh10.name: Drifloon
swsh10.effect: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

swsh10.name: Drifblim
swsh10.effect: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.

swsh10.name: Uxie
swsh10.effect: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

swsh10.name: Mesprit
swsh10.effect: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

swsh10.name: Azelf
swsh10.effect: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.

swsh10.name: Diancie
swsh10.effect: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

swsh10.name: Wyrdeer
swsh10.effect: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Growlithe
swsh10.effect: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Arcanine
swsh10.effect: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

swsh10.name: Machamp V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Machamp VMAX
swsh10.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Sudowoodo
swsh10.effect: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

swsh10.name: Regirock
swsh10.effect: Every bit of Regirock's body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what's been lost.

swsh10.name: Cranidos
swsh10.effect: Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It snapped trees by headbutting them, and then it fed on their ripe berries.

swsh10.name: Rampardos
swsh10.effect: This ancient Pokémon used headbutts skillfully. Its brain was really small, so some theories suggest that its stupidity led to its extinction.

swsh10.name: Lucario V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Hippopotas
swsh10.effect: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

swsh10.name: Hippowdon
swsh10.effect: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

swsh10.name: Radiant Hawlucha
swsh10.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Decidueye
swsh10.effect: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Decidueye V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Decidueye VSTAR
swsh10.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Kleavor
swsh10.effect: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Qwilfish
swsh10.effect: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Qwilfish
swsh10.effect: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Overqwil
swsh10.effect: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Overqwil
swsh10.effect: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Sneasel
swsh10.effect: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Sneasler
swsh10.effect: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Sneasler V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Poochyena
swsh10.effect: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

swsh10.name: Mightyena
swsh10.effect: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

swsh10.name: Absol
swsh10.effect: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

swsh10.name: Darkrai V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Darkrai VSTAR
swsh10.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Samurott
swsh10.effect: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Samurott V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Samurott VSTAR
swsh10.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Nickit
swsh10.effect: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

swsh10.name: Thievul
swsh10.effect: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

swsh10.name: Magnemite
swsh10.effect: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

swsh10.name: Magneton
swsh10.effect: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.

swsh10.name: Magnezone
swsh10.effect: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

swsh10.name: Registeel
swsh10.effect: Registeel's body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.

swsh10.name: Shieldon
swsh10.effect: Although its fossils can be found in layers of primeval rock, nothing but its face has ever been discovered.

swsh10.name: Bastiodon
swsh10.effect: This Pokémon is from roughly 100 million years ago. Its terrifyingly tough face is harder than steel.

swsh10.name: Bronzor
swsh10.effect: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

swsh10.name: Bronzong
swsh10.effect: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

swsh10.name: Origin Forme Dialga V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Origin Forme Dialga VSTAR
swsh10.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Pawniard
swsh10.effect: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

swsh10.name: Bisharp
swsh10.effect: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

swsh10.name: Garchomp V
swsh10.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh10.name: Regidrago
swsh10.effect: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

swsh10.name: Eevee
swsh10.effect: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

swsh10.name: Hoothoot
swsh10.effect: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

swsh10.name: Noctowl
swsh10.effect: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

swsh10.name: Teddiursa
swsh10.effect: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

swsh10.name: Ursaring
swsh10.effect: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

swsh10.name: Ursaluna
swsh10.effect: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

swsh10.name: Stantler
swsh10.effect: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

swsh10.name: Miltank
swsh10.effect: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

swsh10.name: Glameow
swsh10.effect: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

swsh10.name: Purugly
swsh10.effect: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

swsh10.name: Chatot
swsh10.effect: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

swsh10.name: Regigigas
swsh10.effect: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

swsh10.name: Rufflet
swsh10.effect: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

swsh10.name: Hisuian Braviary
swsh10.effect: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

swsh10tg.name: Abomasnow
swsh10tg.effect: The Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.

swsh10tg.name: Flapple
swsh10tg.effect: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

swsh10tg.name: Kingdra
swsh10tg.effect: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

swsh10tg.name: Frosmoth
swsh10tg.effect: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

swsh10tg.name: Gardevoir
swsh10tg.effect: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

swsh10tg.name: Wyrdeer
swsh10tg.effect: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

swsh10tg.name: Falinks
swsh10tg.effect: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

swsh10tg.name: Kleavor
swsh10tg.effect: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

swsh10tg.name: Mightyena
swsh10tg.effect: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

swsh10tg.name: Galarian Obstagoon
swsh10tg.effect: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

swsh10tg.name: Bronzong
swsh10tg.effect: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

swsh10tg.name: Hoothoot
swsh10tg.effect: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

pgo.name: Bulbasaur
pgo.effect: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

pgo.name: Ivysaur
pgo.effect: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

pgo.name: Venusaur
pgo.effect: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

pgo.name: Radiant Venusaur
pgo.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

pgo.name: Alolan Exeggutor V
pgo.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

pgo.name: Spinarak
pgo.effect: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

pgo.name: Ariados
pgo.effect: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

pgo.name: Charmander
pgo.effect: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

pgo.name: Charmeleon
pgo.effect: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

pgo.name: Charizard
pgo.effect: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

pgo.name: Radiant Charizard
pgo.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

pgo.name: Moltres
pgo.effect: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

pgo.name: Numel
pgo.effect: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

pgo.name: Camerupt
pgo.effect: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

pgo.name: Squirtle
pgo.effect: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

pgo.name: Wartortle
pgo.effect: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

pgo.name: Blastoise
pgo.effect: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

pgo.name: Radiant Blastoise
pgo.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

pgo.name: Slowpoke
pgo.effect: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won't feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won't notice when its tail grows back, either.

pgo.name: Slowbro
pgo.effect: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.

pgo.name: Magikarp
pgo.effect: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

pgo.name: Gyarados
pgo.effect: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

pgo.name: Lapras
pgo.effect: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

pgo.name: Articuno
pgo.effect: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

pgo.name: Wimpod
pgo.effect: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

pgo.name: Golisopod
pgo.effect: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

pgo.name: Pikachu
pgo.effect: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

pgo.name: Pikachu
pgo.effect: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

pgo.name: Zapdos
pgo.effect: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

pgo.name: Natu
pgo.effect: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

pgo.name: Xatu
pgo.effect: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

pgo.name: Lunatone
pgo.effect: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

pgo.name: Sylveon
pgo.effect: By releasing enmity-erasing waves from its ribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.

pgo.name: Onix
pgo.effect: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

pgo.name: Larvitar
pgo.effect: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

pgo.name: Pupitar
pgo.effect: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

pgo.name: Solrock
pgo.effect: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

pgo.name: Conkeldurr V
pgo.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

pgo.name: Alolan Rattata
pgo.effect: Night after night, they sneak into people's homes seeking food. A massive outbreak of them has become an issue of public concern.

pgo.name: Alolan Raticate
pgo.effect: It commands a nest of Rattata. Different nests don't get along, whipping up severe fights over feeding grounds.

pgo.name: Tyranitar
pgo.effect: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

pgo.name: Steelix
pgo.effect: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

pgo.name: Meltan
pgo.effect: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

pgo.name: Melmetal
pgo.effect: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

pgo.name: Chansey
pgo.effect: The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It's used as a high-class cooking ingredient.

pgo.name: Blissey
pgo.effect: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokémon is all better.

pgo.name: Ditto
pgo.effect: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

pgo.name: Eevee
pgo.effect: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

pgo.name: Snorlax
pgo.effect: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

pgo.name: Aipom
pgo.effect: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.

pgo.name: Ambipom
pgo.effect: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

pgo.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

pgo.name: Bidoof
pgo.effect: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

pgo.name: Bibarel
pgo.effect: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

pgo.name: Pidove
pgo.effect: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

pgo.name: Tranquill
pgo.effect: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

pgo.name: Unfezant
pgo.effect: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.
