mcd22.name: Ledyba
mcd22.effect: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

mcd22.name: Rowlet
mcd22.effect: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

mcd22.name: Gossifleur
mcd22.effect: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

mcd22.name: Growlithe
mcd22.effect: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

mcd22.name: Victini
mcd22.effect: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

mcd22.name: Lapras
mcd22.effect: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

mcd22.name: Pikachu
mcd22.effect: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

mcd22.name: Chinchou
mcd22.effect: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

mcd22.name: Flaaffy
mcd22.effect: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

mcd22.name: Tynamo
mcd22.effect: One alone can emit only trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

mcd22.name: Cutiefly
mcd22.effect: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

mcd22.name: Bewear
mcd22.effect: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

mcd22.name: Pangoro
mcd22.effect: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

mcd22.name: Drampa
mcd22.effect: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

mcd22.name: Smeargle
mcd22.effect: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

swsh11.name: Oddish
swsh11.effect: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

swsh11.name: Gloom
swsh11.effect: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

swsh11.name: Vileplume
swsh11.effect: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

swsh11.name: Paras
swsh11.effect: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

swsh11.name: Parasect
swsh11.effect: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

swsh11.name: Wurmple
swsh11.effect: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

swsh11.name: Silcoon
swsh11.effect: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

swsh11.name: Beautifly
swsh11.effect: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

swsh11.name: Cascoon
swsh11.effect: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

swsh11.name: Dustox
swsh11.effect: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

swsh11.name: Seedot
swsh11.effect: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

swsh11.name: Nuzleaf
swsh11.effect: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

swsh11.name: Shiftry
swsh11.effect: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

swsh11.name: Roselia
swsh11.effect: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

swsh11.name: Roserade
swsh11.effect: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

swsh11.name: Phantump
swsh11.effect: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.

swsh11.name: Trevenant
swsh11.effect: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

swsh11.name: Blipbug
swsh11.effect: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

swsh11.name: Dottler
swsh11.effect: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

swsh11.name: Orbeetle
swsh11.effect: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

swsh11.name: Slugma
swsh11.effect: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

swsh11.name: Magcargo
swsh11.effect: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

swsh11.name: Torkoal
swsh11.effect: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

swsh11.name: Litwick
swsh11.effect: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

swsh11.name: Lampent
swsh11.effect: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

swsh11.name: Chandelure
swsh11.effect: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

swsh11.name: Delphox V
swsh11.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Litleo
swsh11.effect: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

swsh11.name: Pyroar
swsh11.effect: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

swsh11.name: Poliwag
swsh11.effect: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon's innards showing through the skin.

swsh11.name: Poliwhirl
swsh11.effect: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

swsh11.name: Politoed
swsh11.effect: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

swsh11.name: Seel
swsh11.effect: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

swsh11.name: Dewgong
swsh11.effect: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

swsh11.name: Horsea
swsh11.effect: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

swsh11.name: Seadra
swsh11.effect: It's the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

swsh11.name: Kingdra
swsh11.effect: With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémon will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.

swsh11.name: Luvdisc
swsh11.effect: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

swsh11.name: Shellos
swsh11.effect: There's speculation that its appearance is determined by what it eats, but the truth remains elusive.

swsh11.name: Finneon
swsh11.effect: It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.

swsh11.name: Lumineon
swsh11.effect: They traverse the deep waters as if crawling over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its fins shine like stars in the night sky.

swsh11.name: Snover
swsh11.effect: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

swsh11.name: Abomasnow
swsh11.effect: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

swsh11.name: Hisuian Basculin
swsh11.effect: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

swsh11.name: Hisuian Basculegion
swsh11.effect: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

swsh11.name: Ducklett
swsh11.effect: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

swsh11.name: Swanna
swsh11.effect: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

swsh11.name: Kyurem V
swsh11.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Kyurem VMAX
swsh11.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Cramorant
swsh11.effect: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

swsh11.name: Glastrier
swsh11.effect: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

swsh11.name: Pikachu
swsh11.effect: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

swsh11.name: Raichu
swsh11.effect: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

swsh11.name: Electrike
swsh11.effect: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

swsh11.name: Manectric
swsh11.effect: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

swsh11.name: Magnezone V
swsh11.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Magnezone VSTAR
swsh11.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Rotom V
swsh11.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Tynamo
swsh11.effect: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

swsh11.name: Eelektrik
swsh11.effect: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

swsh11.name: Eelektross
swsh11.effect: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

swsh11.name: Clefairy
swsh11.effect: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

swsh11.name: Clefable
swsh11.effect: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

swsh11.name: Gastly
swsh11.effect: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

swsh11.name: Haunter
swsh11.effect: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

swsh11.name: Gengar
swsh11.effect: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

swsh11.name: Mr. Mime
swsh11.effect: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

swsh11.name: Jynx
swsh11.effect: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

swsh11.name: Radiant Gardevoir
swsh11.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

swsh11.name: Sableye
swsh11.effect: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

swsh11.name: Mawile
swsh11.effect: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

swsh11.name: Shuppet
swsh11.effect: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

swsh11.name: Banette
swsh11.effect: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

swsh11.name: Cresselia
swsh11.effect: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

swsh11.name: Hisuian Zorua
swsh11.effect: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

swsh11.name: Hisuian Zoroark
swsh11.effect: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

swsh11.name: Inkay
swsh11.effect: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

swsh11.name: Malamar
swsh11.effect: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

swsh11.name: Comfey
swsh11.effect: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

swsh11.name: Mimikyu
swsh11.effect: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

swsh11.name: Spectrier
swsh11.effect: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

swsh11.name: Enamorus V
swsh11.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Hisuian Growlithe
swsh11.effect: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

swsh11.name: Hisuian Arcanine
swsh11.effect: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

swsh11.name: Poliwrath
swsh11.effect: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

swsh11.name: Machop
swsh11.effect: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

swsh11.name: Machoke
swsh11.effect: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

swsh11.name: Machamp
swsh11.effect: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

swsh11.name: Rhyhorn
swsh11.effect: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

swsh11.name: Rhydon
swsh11.effect: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

swsh11.name: Rhyperior
swsh11.effect: It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.

swsh11.name: Aerodactyl V
swsh11.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Aerodactyl VSTAR
swsh11.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Sudowoodo
swsh11.effect: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

swsh11.name: Gligar
swsh11.effect: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

swsh11.name: Gliscor
swsh11.effect: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

swsh11.name: Makuhita
swsh11.effect: There's a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

swsh11.name: Hariyama
swsh11.effect: Hariyama that are big and fat aren't necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

swsh11.name: Meditite
swsh11.effect: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

swsh11.name: Medicham
swsh11.effect: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

swsh11.name: Relicanth
swsh11.effect: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

swsh11.name: Gastrodon
swsh11.effect: Its search for food sometimes leads it onto land, where it leaves behind a sticky trail of slime as it passes through.

swsh11.name: Mienfoo
swsh11.effect: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

swsh11.name: Mienshao
swsh11.effect: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.

swsh11.name: Landorus
swsh11.effect: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

swsh11.name: Binacle
swsh11.effect: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

swsh11.name: Barbaracle
swsh11.effect: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

swsh11.name: Carbink
swsh11.effect: When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them all out by firing high-energy beams from the gems embedded in its body.

swsh11.name: Rockruff
swsh11.effect: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

swsh11.name: Falinks
swsh11.effect: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

swsh11.name: Stonjourner
swsh11.effect: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

swsh11.name: Spinarak
swsh11.effect: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

swsh11.name: Ariados
swsh11.effect: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

swsh11.name: Murkrow
swsh11.effect: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

swsh11.name: Honchkrow
swsh11.effect: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

swsh11.name: Seviper
swsh11.effect: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It's Zangoose's archrival.

swsh11.name: Spiritomb
swsh11.effect: Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.

swsh11.name: Drapion V
swsh11.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Drapion VSTAR
swsh11.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Darkrai
swsh11.effect: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

swsh11.name: Inkay
swsh11.effect: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

swsh11.name: Hoopa
swsh11.effect: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

swsh11.name: Radiant Hisuian Sneasler
swsh11.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

swsh11.name: Radiant Steelix
swsh11.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

swsh11.name: Bronzor
swsh11.effect: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn't come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

swsh11.name: Bronzong
swsh11.effect: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

swsh11.name: Galarian Stunfisk
swsh11.effect: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

swsh11.name: Magearna
swsh11.effect: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

swsh11.name: Galarian Perrserker V
swsh11.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Giratina V
swsh11.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Giratina VSTAR
swsh11.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Goomy
swsh11.effect: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

swsh11.name: Hisuian Sliggoo
swsh11.effect: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

swsh11.name: Hisuian Goodra
swsh11.effect: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

swsh11.name: Hisuian Goodra V
swsh11.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Hisuian Goodra VSTAR
swsh11.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Pidgeot V
swsh11.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Lickitung
swsh11.effect: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.

swsh11.name: Lickilicky
swsh11.effect: Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky's tongue can stretch so far.

swsh11.name: Porygon
swsh11.effect: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.

swsh11.name: Porygon2
swsh11.effect: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.

swsh11.name: Porygon-Z
swsh11.effect: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z's behavior.

swsh11.name: Snorlax
swsh11.effect: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

swsh11.name: Aipom
swsh11.effect: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

swsh11.name: Ambipom
swsh11.effect: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

swsh11.name: Hisuian Zoroark V
swsh11.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Hisuian Zoroark VSTAR
swsh11.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11.name: Bouffalant
swsh11.effect: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

swsh11.name: Komala
swsh11.effect: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

swsh11.name: Skwovet
swsh11.effect: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

swsh11.name: Greedent
swsh11.effect: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

swsh11.name: Arc Phone
swsh11.effect: Look at the top card of your deck. You may switch that card with 1 of your face-down Prize cards. (The cards stay face down.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh11.name: Arezu
swsh11.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Evolution Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes.) You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11.name: Box of Disaster
swsh11.effect: If the Pokémon V this card is attached to has full HP and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, put 8 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh11.effect: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put 3 of them into your hand. Put the other cards in the Lost Zone. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11.effect: Move up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

(This includes Pokémon that come into play during that turn.) You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11.name: Lake Acuity
swsh11.effect: All Pokémon that have any Water or Fighting Energy attached (both yours and your opponent's) take 20 less damage from attacks from the opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

swsh11.name: Lost City
swsh11.effect: Whenever a Pokémon (either yours or your opponent's) is Knocked Out, put that Pokémon in the Lost Zone instead of the discard pile. (Discard all attached cards.)

swsh11.name: Lost Vacuum
swsh11.effect: You can use this card only if you put another card from your hand in the Lost Zone. Choose a Pokémon Tool attached to any Pokémon, or any Stadium in play, and put it in the Lost Zone. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh11.name: Mirage Gate
swsh11.effect: You can use this card only if you have 7 or more cards in the Lost Zone. Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards of different types and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh11.name: Miss Fortune Sisters
swsh11.effect: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and discard any number of Item cards you find there. Your opponent shuffles the other cards back into their deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11.name: Panic Mask
swsh11.effect: Prevent all damage done to the Pokémon this card is attached to by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have 40 HP or less remaining. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh11.name: Riley
swsh11.effect: Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck and have your opponent choose 2 of them. Discard the chosen cards and put the remaining cards into your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11.name: Thorton
swsh11.effect: Choose a Basic Pokémon in your discard pile and switch it with 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11.name: Tool Box
swsh11.effect: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Pokémon Tool cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh11.name: Volo
swsh11.effect: Discard 1 of your Benched Pokémon V and all attached cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11.name: Windup Arm
swsh11.effect: The Pokémon this card is attached to can attack even if it's Asleep or Paralyzed. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh11.effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy. If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

swsh11tg.name: Parasect
swsh11tg.effect: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.

swsh11tg.name: Roserade
swsh11tg.effect: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

swsh11tg.name: Charizard
swsh11tg.effect: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

swsh11tg.name: Chandelure
swsh11tg.effect: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

swsh11tg.name: Pikachu
swsh11tg.effect: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

swsh11tg.name: Gengar
swsh11tg.effect: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

swsh11tg.name: Banette
swsh11tg.effect: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

swsh11tg.name: Hisuian Arcanine
swsh11tg.effect: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

swsh11tg.name: Spiritomb
swsh11tg.effect: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

swsh11tg.name: Snorlax
swsh11tg.effect: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

swsh11tg.name: Castform
swsh11tg.effect: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

swsh11tg.name: Orbeetle V
swsh11tg.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11tg.name: Orbeetle VMAX
swsh11tg.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh11tg.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11tg.name: Centiskorch VMAX
swsh11tg.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh11tg.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11tg.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh11tg.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11tg.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11tg.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh11tg.name: Adventurer's Discovery
swsh11tg.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon V, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11tg.name: Boss's Orders
swsh11tg.effect: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11tg.name: Cook
swsh11tg.effect: Heal 70 damage from your Active Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11tg.name: Kabu
swsh11tg.effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If your Active Pokémon is your only Pokémon in play, draw 8 cards instead. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11tg.name: Nessa
swsh11tg.effect: Put up to 4 in any combination of Water Pokémon and Water Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11tg.name: Opal
swsh11tg.effect: Flip 2 coins. Search your deck for a number of cards up to the number of heads, put them into your hand, and shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh11tg.name: Pikachu VMAX
swsh11tg.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh11tg.name: Mew VMAX
swsh11tg.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Venonat
swsh12.effect: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

swsh12.name: Venomoth
swsh12.effect: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

swsh12.name: Spinarak
swsh12.effect: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

swsh12.name: Ariados
swsh12.effect: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

swsh12.name: Sunkern
swsh12.effect: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

swsh12.name: Sunflora
swsh12.effect: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

swsh12.name: Serperior V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Serperior VSTAR
swsh12.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Petilil
swsh12.effect: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

swsh12.name: Hisuian Lilligant
swsh12.effect: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

swsh12.name: Foongus
swsh12.effect: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

swsh12.name: Amoonguss
swsh12.effect: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

swsh12.name: Durant
swsh12.effect: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

swsh12.name: Virizion
swsh12.effect: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

swsh12.name: Chesnaught V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Radiant Tsareena
swsh12.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

swsh12.name: Vulpix
swsh12.effect: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

swsh12.name: Ninetales
swsh12.effect: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

swsh12.name: Growlithe
swsh12.effect: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

swsh12.name: Arcanine
swsh12.effect: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

swsh12.name: Ponyta
swsh12.effect: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

swsh12.name: Rapidash
swsh12.effect: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

swsh12.name: Victini
swsh12.effect: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

swsh12.name: Reshiram V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Fennekin
swsh12.effect: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

swsh12.name: Braixen
swsh12.effect: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

swsh12.name: Delphox
swsh12.effect: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

swsh12.name: Fletchinder
swsh12.effect: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder's sharp talons finish it off.

swsh12.name: Talonflame
swsh12.effect: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.

swsh12.name: Litten
swsh12.effect: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

swsh12.name: Torracat
swsh12.effect: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it's feeling good. When it isn't feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.

swsh12.name: Incineroar
swsh12.effect: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.

swsh12.name: Alolan Vulpix V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Alolan Vulpix VSTAR
swsh12.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Omastar V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Articuno
swsh12.effect: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

swsh12.name: Wailmer
swsh12.effect: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

swsh12.name: Wailord
swsh12.effect: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

swsh12.name: Feebas
swsh12.effect: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

swsh12.name: Milotic
swsh12.effect: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

swsh12.name: Snorunt
swsh12.effect: It's said that if they are seen at midnight, they'll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.

swsh12.name: Glalie
swsh12.effect: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

swsh12.name: Froslass
swsh12.effect: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.

swsh12.name: Relicanth
swsh12.effect: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

swsh12.name: Phione
swsh12.effect: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

swsh12.name: Keldeo
swsh12.effect: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

swsh12.name: Dewpider
swsh12.effect: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

swsh12.name: Araquanid
swsh12.effect: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

swsh12.name: Pikachu
swsh12.effect: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

swsh12.name: Raichu
swsh12.effect: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

swsh12.name: Chinchou
swsh12.effect: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

swsh12.name: Lanturn
swsh12.effect: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

swsh12.name: Rotom
swsh12.effect: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

swsh12.name: Emolga
swsh12.effect: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

swsh12.name: Stunfisk
swsh12.effect: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

swsh12.name: Zeraora
swsh12.effect: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

swsh12.name: Regieleki V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Regieleki VMAX
swsh12.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Radiant Alakazam
swsh12.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

swsh12.name: Drowzee
swsh12.effect: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

swsh12.name: Hypno
swsh12.effect: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

swsh12.name: Jynx
swsh12.effect: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

swsh12.name: Misdreavus
swsh12.effect: What makes it happy is imitating the voices of weeping people and scaring everyone. It doesn't deal well with folks who aren't easily frightened.

swsh12.name: Mismagius
swsh12.effect: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

swsh12.name: Unown V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Unown VSTAR
swsh12.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Ralts
swsh12.effect: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

swsh12.name: Kirlia
swsh12.effect: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

swsh12.name: Gardevoir
swsh12.effect: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

swsh12.name: Mawile V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Mawile VSTAR
swsh12.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Meditite
swsh12.effect: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

swsh12.name: Medicham
swsh12.effect: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

swsh12.name: Chimecho
swsh12.effect: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

swsh12.name: Sigilyph
swsh12.effect: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

swsh12.name: Solosis
swsh12.effect: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

swsh12.name: Duosion
swsh12.effect: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.

swsh12.name: Reuniclus
swsh12.effect: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

swsh12.name: Elgyem
swsh12.effect: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

swsh12.name: Beheeyem
swsh12.effect: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

swsh12.name: Espurr
swsh12.effect: Though Espurr's expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.

swsh12.name: Meowstic
swsh12.effect: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

swsh12.name: Swirlix
swsh12.effect: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

swsh12.name: Slurpuff
swsh12.effect: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

swsh12.name: Dedenne
swsh12.effect: A Dedenne's whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.

swsh12.name: Indeedee
swsh12.effect: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

swsh12.name: Dreepy
swsh12.effect: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

swsh12.name: Drakloak
swsh12.effect: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

swsh12.name: Dragapult
swsh12.effect: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

swsh12.name: Hisuian Arcanine V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Phanpy
swsh12.effect: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

swsh12.name: Donphan
swsh12.effect: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

swsh12.name: Baltoy
swsh12.effect: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

swsh12.name: Claydol
swsh12.effect: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

swsh12.name: Anorith
swsh12.effect: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.

swsh12.name: Armaldo
swsh12.effect: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.

swsh12.name: Terrakion
swsh12.effect: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

swsh12.name: Hawlucha
swsh12.effect: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

swsh12.name: Sandygast
swsh12.effect: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.

swsh12.name: Palossand
swsh12.effect: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

swsh12.name: Stonjourner
swsh12.effect: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

swsh12.name: Ursaluna V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Zubat
swsh12.effect: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

swsh12.name: Golbat
swsh12.effect: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

swsh12.name: Crobat
swsh12.effect: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

swsh12.name: Murkrow
swsh12.effect: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

swsh12.name: Honchkrow
swsh12.effect: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

swsh12.name: Skuntank V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Croagunk
swsh12.effect: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

swsh12.name: Toxicroak
swsh12.effect: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

swsh12.name: Sandile
swsh12.effect: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

swsh12.name: Krokorok
swsh12.effect: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

swsh12.name: Krookodile
swsh12.effect: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

swsh12.name: Mareanie
swsh12.effect: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

swsh12.name: Toxapex
swsh12.effect: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

swsh12.name: Morpeko
swsh12.effect: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.

swsh12.name: Beldum
swsh12.effect: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum's sharp claws.

swsh12.name: Metang
swsh12.effect: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

swsh12.name: Metagross
swsh12.effect: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

swsh12.name: Radiant Jirachi
swsh12.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

swsh12.name: Ferroseed
swsh12.effect: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

swsh12.name: Ferrothorn
swsh12.effect: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

swsh12.name: Klink
swsh12.effect: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

swsh12.name: Klang
swsh12.effect: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

swsh12.name: Klinklang
swsh12.effect: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

swsh12.name: Cobalion
swsh12.effect: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region's Pokémon.

swsh12.name: Togedemaru
swsh12.effect: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

swsh12.name: Magearna V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Dratini
swsh12.effect: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

swsh12.name: Dragonair
swsh12.effect: This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes. It can control the weather, and it uses this power to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.

swsh12.name: Dragonite
swsh12.effect: It's a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.

swsh12.name: Noibat
swsh12.effect: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.

swsh12.name: Noivern
swsh12.effect: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

swsh12.name: Zygarde
swsh12.effect: Born when around 10% of Zygarde's cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.

swsh12.name: Regidrago V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Regidrago VSTAR
swsh12.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Smeargle
swsh12.effect: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

swsh12.name: Lugia V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Lugia VSTAR
swsh12.effect: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Ho-Oh V
swsh12.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12.name: Spinda
swsh12.effect: Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents' attacks brilliantly!

swsh12.name: Swablu
swsh12.effect: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.

swsh12.name: Altaria
swsh12.effect: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.

swsh12.name: Buneary
swsh12.effect: If both of Buneary's ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It's a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

swsh12.name: Lopunny
swsh12.effect: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

swsh12.name: Archen
swsh12.effect: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it's very good at jumping.

swsh12.name: Archeops
swsh12.effect: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

swsh12.name: Rufflet
swsh12.effect: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

swsh12.name: Hisuian Braviary
swsh12.effect: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

swsh12.name: Fletchling
swsh12.effect: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.

swsh12.name: Brandon
swsh12.effect: You can use this card only when it is the last card in your hand. Draw a card for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's). You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh12.name: Candice
swsh12.effect: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Water Pokémon and Water Energy cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh12.name: Capturing Aroma
swsh12.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh12.name: Earthen Seal Stone
swsh12.effect: The Pokémon V this card is attached to can use the VSTAR Power on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

swsh12.name: Emergency Jelly
swsh12.effect: At the end of each turn, if the Pokémon this card is attached to has 30 HP or less remaining and has any damage counters on it, heal 120 damage from it. swsh12pt5.effect: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

swsh12pt5.name: Heliolisk
swsh12pt5.effect: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

swsh12pt5.name: Radiant Charjabug
swsh12pt5.effect: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

swsh12pt5.name: Zeraora
swsh12pt5.effect: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

swsh12pt5.name: Pincurchin
swsh12pt5.effect: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

swsh12pt5.name: Exeggcute
swsh12pt5.effect: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

swsh12pt5.name: Exeggutor
swsh12pt5.effect: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

swsh12pt5.name: Mewtwo
swsh12pt5.effect: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

swsh12pt5.name: Mew V
swsh12pt5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12pt5.name: Girafarig
swsh12pt5.effect: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

swsh12pt5.name: Lunatone
swsh12pt5.effect: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

swsh12pt5.name: Dusclops
swsh12pt5.effect: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

swsh12pt5.name: Tapu Lele
swsh12pt5.effect: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

swsh12pt5.name: Hatterene V
swsh12pt5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12pt5.name: Hatterene VMAX
swsh12pt5.effect: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

swsh12pt5.name: Enamorus
swsh12pt5.effect: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

swsh12pt5.name: Graveler
swsh12pt5.effect: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

swsh12pt5.name: Solrock
swsh12pt5.effect: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

swsh12pt5.name: Baltoy
swsh12pt5.effect: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

swsh12pt5.name: Riolu
swsh12pt5.effect: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

swsh12pt5.name: Pancham
swsh12pt5.effect: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master's actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.

swsh12pt5.name: Rockruff
swsh12pt5.effect: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

swsh12pt5.name: Lycanroc
swsh12pt5.effect: This form of Lycanroc is reckless. It charges headlong at its opponents, attacking without any care about what injuries it might receive.

swsh12pt5.name: Koffing
swsh12pt5.effect: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

swsh12pt5.name: Absol
swsh12pt5.effect: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

swsh12pt5.name: Purrloin
swsh12pt5.effect: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

swsh12pt5.name: Liepard
swsh12pt5.effect: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

swsh12pt5.name: Krokorok
swsh12pt5.effect: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

swsh12pt5.name: Pangoro
swsh12pt5.effect: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

swsh12pt5.name: Skrelp
swsh12pt5.effect: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.

swsh12pt5.name: Dragalge
swsh12pt5.effect: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.

swsh12pt5.name: Hoopa
swsh12pt5.effect: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

swsh12pt5.name: Galarian Meowth
swsh12pt5.effect: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

swsh12pt5.name: Galarian Perrserker
swsh12pt5.effect: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

swsh12pt5.name: Scizor
swsh12pt5.effect: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor's body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.

swsh12pt5.name: Aron
swsh12pt5.effect: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

swsh12pt5.name: Lairon
swsh12pt5.effect: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

swsh12pt5.name: Aggron
swsh12pt5.effect: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

swsh12pt5.name: Metang
swsh12pt5.effect: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

swsh12pt5.name: Pawniard
swsh12pt5.effect: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

swsh12pt5.name: Pawniard

swsh12pt5.name: Zacian
swsh12pt5.effect: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

swsh12pt5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12pt5.effect: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

swsh12pt5.effect: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

swsh12pt5.name: Chatot

swsh12pt5.name: Gumshoos
swsh12pt5.effect: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

swsh12pt5.name: Oranguru
swsh12pt5.effect: With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokémon.

swsh12pt5.name: Greedent V
swsh12pt5.effect: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

swsh12pt5.name: Wooloo
swsh12pt5.effect: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

swsh12pt5.name: Dubwool
swsh12pt5.effect: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

swsh12pt5.name: Energy Switch

swsh12pt5.effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh12pt5.name: Rescue Carrier

swsh12pt5.name: Sky Seal Stone

swsh12pt5.name: Switch
swsh12pt5.effect: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

swsh12pt5.effect: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

swsh12pt5gg.effect: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Kricketune
swsh12pt5gg.effect: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Magmortar
swsh12pt5gg.effect: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Oricorio
swsh12pt5gg.effect: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Lapras
swsh12pt5gg.effect: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Manaphy
swsh12pt5gg.effect: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Keldeo
swsh12pt5gg.effect: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Electivire
swsh12pt5gg.effect: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Toxtricity
swsh12pt5gg.effect: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Mew
swsh12pt5gg.effect: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Lunatone
swsh12pt5gg.effect: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Deoxys
swsh12pt5gg.effect: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Diancie
swsh12pt5gg.effect: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Comfey
swsh12pt5gg.effect: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Solrock
swsh12pt5gg.effect: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Magnezone
swsh12pt5gg.effect: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Altaria
swsh12pt5gg.effect: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Latias
swsh12pt5gg.effect: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Hisuian Goodra

swsh12pt5gg.effect: You can use this card only if you discard 2 Metal Energy cards from your hand. Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Cheren's Care
swsh12pt5gg.effect: Put 1 of your Colorless Pokémon that has any damage counters on it and all attached cards into your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Colress's Experiment
swsh12pt5gg.effect: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put 3 of them into your hand. Put the other cards in the Lost Zone. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Cynthia's Ambition
swsh12pt5gg.effect: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand instead. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Gardenia's Vigor
swsh12pt5gg.effect: Draw 2 cards. If you drew any cards in this way, attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Grant
swsh12pt5gg.effect: During this turn, your Fighting Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). During your turn, if this Grant is in your discard pile, you may discard 2 cards, except any Grant, from your hand. If you do, put this Grant into your hand. (This effect doesn't use up your Supporter card for the turn.) You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Irida
swsh12pt5gg.effect: Search your deck for a Water Pokémon and an Item card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Melony
swsh12pt5gg.effect: Attach a Water Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon V. If you do, draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

swsh12pt5gg.name: Raihan
swsh12pt5gg.effect: You can play this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn. Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.
